sa: दमनं चापि दायादं पौरवस्य महात्मनः। जघान विमलाचेण नाराचेन परंतपः॥
en: That O chastiser of foes, then, with a broadheaded arrow killed Damana, the son of Paurava.

sa: ततः प्रहस्य बीभत्सुर्व्याक्षिपन् गाण्डिवं धनुः॥ गाङ्गेयं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समार्पयत्।
en: Then smiling and stretching his bow Gandiva, Vibhatsu wounded Ganga's son with twenty-five short thick shafts.

sa: कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च चित्रसेनो विविंशतिः। दुःशासनमुखा यत्ताः सव्यं पक्षमपालयन्॥
en: Then Kripa, Kritavarman, Chitrasena and Vivinsati, having Dushasana at their head, proceeded, covering the left wing.

sa: ततः शिखण्डी तत् सर्वमखिलेन न्यवेदयत्। तस्मै यक्षप्रधानाय स्थूणाकर्णाय भारत॥
en: Thereupon Shikhandin related to that chief of the Yakshas, named Sthunakarma, 0 Bharata, everything in detail.

sa: शिखण्डी तु समासाद्य भरतानां पितामहम्। इषुभिस्तूर्णमव्यग्रो बहुभिः स समाचिनोत्॥
en: Then Shikhandin confronting the grandsire of the Bharatas, pierced patiently the latter with myriad's of shafts.

sa: ततो मद्रेश्वरं राजा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। छादयामास संक्रुद्धस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: The king, then saying in great wrath “Wait" covered the king of Madra with straight arrows.

sa: इदमस्त्रं सुदयितं प्रत्यभिज्ञास्यते भवान्। विदितं हि तवाप्येतत् पूर्वस्मिन् देहधारणे॥
en: This well-beloved weapon you will recognize for it was known to you in your previous birth.

sa: रथे भीष्मस्य चिक्षेप यथा देवो धनेश्वरः। तया भीष्मनिपातिन्या स रथो भस्मसात्कृतः॥ सध्वजः सह सूतेन साश्वः सयुगबन्धुरः। विरथं रथिनां श्रेष्ठं भीष्मं दृष्ट्वा रथोत्तमाः॥ वै॥
en: Hurled it on Bhishma's car like the dcity Maheshvara (Shiva). By the fall of that mace intended for Bhishma's destruction, that car. with its standard, charioteer and horses, was reduced to ashes. Seeing Bhishrma, that foremost of car-warriors fighting on foot.

sa: षष्ट्या रथसहस्रेस्तु नागानामयुतेन च। पतिः सर्वकलिङ्गानां ययौ केतुमता सह॥
en: With sixty thousand cars and ten thousand clephants the kings of the Kalingas with Ketuman marched.

sa: ततः कर्ण शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिमन्यु दुरासदम्॥ अभ्यवर्षत संक्रुद्धः पुत्रस्य हितकृत् तव।
en: Thereupon inflamed with wrath Karna ever bent on doing good to your son, covered the arrows.

sa: नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन भृशं विद्ध्वा ह्यकम्पयत्। शिखण्ड्यपि ततो राजन् द्रोणपुत्रमताडयत्॥
en: O king, Shikhandin also wounded the son of Drona (Ashvatthama) with a sharp and excellent weapon.

sa: तस्मिंश्च निधनं प्राप्ते सत्यवत्या मते स्थितः। विचित्रवीर्यं राजानमभ्यषिञ्च यथाविधि॥
en: He too being dead, following the wishes of Satyavati 1 duly appointed Vichitravirya in the kingship.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। नारदस्य च संवादं देवलस्यासितस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old discourse that took place between Narada, and Asita-Devala.

sa: ते तमूचुर्महाराज राजप्रेष्यास्तदा द्विजम्। त्वरस्व तूर्णमागच्छ राजा त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति॥
en: The royal messengers, O monarch, said to that Brahmana,-Come quickly, the king wishes to see you.

sa: मणिभद्र उवाच उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते कृतकृत्यः सुखी भव। धनार्थी यदि विप्रोऽयं धनमस्मै प्रदीयताम्॥ यावद् धनं प्रार्थयते ब्राह्मणोऽयं सखा तव। देवानां शासनात् तावदसंख्येयं ददाम्यहम्॥
en: Rise, Rise up, O Kundadhara; Your prayer has borne success! Be you happy! If this Brahmana seeks riches, let as much wealth be given to him, as he wishes. at the command of the gods I shall give him immeasurable riches.

sa: मृत्युनाभ्याहतं लोकं व्याधिभिश्चोपपीडितम्। अवृत्तिकर्शितं चैव यः पश्यति स मुच्यते॥
en: That man becomes certainly freed who seeks the world as afflicted by death, disease and famine.

sa: निर्वेष्टुकामस्तु पुरा अष्टावक्रो महातपाः। ऋषेरथ वदान्यस्य ववे कन्यां महात्मनः॥
en: Formerly Ashtavakra of austere penances, desirous of marriage, begged the great Rishi Vadanya of his daughter.

sa: तामोघवान् ददौ तस्मै स्वयमोघवतीं सुताम्। सुदर्शनाय विदुषे भार्यार्थं देवरूपिणीम्॥
en: King Oghavat gave his daughter Oghavati, beautiful as a goddess, 10 the learned Sudarshana, for wife.

sa: ततः स देहमोक्षार्थं सम्प्रहृष्टेन चेतसा॥ अभ्यधावत वर्धन्तं पावकं लुब्धकस्तदा।
en: The fowler, desirous of renouncing his body, ran with a delighted heart towards that spreading fire.

sa: किंनराचरितं देशं पश्य शत्रुघ्न पर्वते। हयैः समन्तादाकीर्णं मकरैरिव सागरम्॥
en: O Śatrughna, behold the realms inhabited by Kinnaras, scattered with steeds, like the main with makaras.

sa: तां कथां कौशिको रामे निवेद्य मधुराक्षराम्। पुनरेवापरं वाक्यं काकुत्स्थमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having said those words to Rāma, composed of melodious letters, Kausika again spoke to Kākutstha, saying,

sa: आगच्छन्तं त्रिशिरसं राक्षसं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः। धनुषा प्रतिजग्राह विधुन्वन् सायकाशितान्॥
en: And seeing that the Rākşasa Trisirã was advancing, Raghava resisted (his attack) by discharging sharpened shafts.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा वसिष्ठो जपतां वरः। विश्वामित्रं तदा वाक्यं सरोषमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having said this, that best of mantra reciting ones, Vasistha, in high wrath, addressed Viśvāmitra, saying.

sa: अथास्य चपला माता तत् स्वकर्म यथातथम्। तेनैव स्त्रीस्वभावेन व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Thereat his volatile mother, influenced by her feminine nature, related faithfully to him her own doings.

sa: बलमिच्छामहे ज्ञातुं भूयश्चास्य पराक्रमम्। त्वां विजेष्यत्युपायेन विषादं वा गमिष्यति॥
en: We are anxious to learn if he defeat you by some means or comes by grief."

sa: अभिषेक्ष्यन्ति काकुत्स्थमयोध्यायां द्विजातयः। अपि मे देवताः कुर्युरिमं सत्यं मनोरथम्॥
en: The twice-born ones will sprinkle Kākutstha in Ayodhyā. May the deities realize this desire of mine!

sa: स सूतो राममादाय लक्ष्मणं मैथिली तथा। जगामाभिमुखस्तूर्णं सकाशं जगतीपतेः॥
en: Thereat the charioteer taking Răma, Lakşmaņa an Mithila's daughter, speedily came before the lord of earth.

sa: अनागतविधानं तु कर्तव्यं शुभमिच्छता। आपदं शङ्कमानेन पुरुषेण विपश्चिता ॥
en: A considerate person that wishes for his welfare, apprehending peril, should prevent disaster ere it arrives.

sa: उत्तिष्ठ तावदाख्याहि प्रमोहं जहि सम्भ्रमम्। व्यक्तमाख्याहि केन त्वमेवंरूपा विरूपिता॥
en: Arise! Leave off fear and amazement. Tell me plainly by whom you have been thus deformed.

sa: श्रूयतां चाभिधास्यामि कौशिकस्य महात्मनः। यथाबलं यथातत्त्वं तन्मे निगतदः शृणु॥
en: Do you listen as I faithfully describe to you the ascetic power of the high-souled Kausika.

sa: ततः सुमन्त्रं द्युतिमान् राजा वचनमब्रवीत्॥ रामः कृतात्मा भवता शीघ्रमानीयतामिति।
en: Then to Sumantra, the effulgent monarch spoke, saying, “Do you speedily bring the virtuous Rāma hither."

sa: ये स्युः सम्पूजिताः सर्वे वसुभिर्भोजनेन च॥ यथा सर्वं सुविहितं न किंचित् परिहीयते। तथा भवन्तः कुर्वन्तु प्रीतियुक्तेन चेतसा ।१७।।
en: And servants, who being entertained with gifts, do everything completely, and omit nothing. And do you, with hearts mollified by love, act so, that all our friends be well pleased with us.

sa: अथ तस्य निनादं तं सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। शुश्रावान्तःपुरगतो वाली भ्रातुरमर्षणः॥
en: While residing in the female apartment, Vāli heard the uproar of that high-souled Sugriva-his wrathful brother.

sa: नूनं काञ्चनपृष्ठस्य विकृष्टस्य मया रणे। द्रष्टुमिच्छसि चापस्य रूपं विद्युद्गणोपमम्।७४।।
en: And ask him if he wishes to behold in battlefield the golden bow resembling a lightning.

sa: भरतस्यार्यपुत्रस्य श्वश्रूणां मम च प्रभो। मृगरूपमिदं दिव्यं विस्मयं जनयिष्यति॥
en: O Lord, truly shall this celestial deer create surprise in Bharata, yourself, me and my mothers-in-law.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं रत्नं ददावन्नं च पुष्कलम्। वासांसि च महार्हाणि रत्नानि विविधानि च। बास्तिकं बहु शुक्लं च गाश्चापि बहुशस्तदा॥ दासीर्दासांश्च यानानि वेश्मानि सुमहान्ति च। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ पुत्रो राज्ञस्तस्यौर्ध्वदेहिकम्॥
en: On the occasion on the ceremonies for the welfare of the departed Spirit, the son of the king conferred on Brāhmaṇas wealth and gems, and rice in abundance, and herds of goats, and silver in profusion, and countless kine, and maidservants and man-servants, and vehicles and spacious mansions.

sa: प्रकृतीश्च समानीय मन्त्रिणश्चैव सम्मतान्॥ मामाह सुहृदां मध्ये वाक्यं परमगर्हितम्।
en: And bringing together the subjects and favourite counsellors, spoke to me, before friends, highly improper words.

sa: स तमध्वानमैक्ष्वाकः सूतं मधुरया गिरा। तं तमर्थमभिप्रेत्य ययौ वाक्यमुदीरयन्॥
en: Taking this subject, the descendant of Ikşvāku passed the way, addressing sweet words to the charioteer.

sa: तस्य काननखण्डेषु निर्झरेषु गुहासु च। रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः॥
en: In its golden tracts, fountains and caves, do you search for Rāvaņa along with Videha's daughter.

sa: सुप्रभाजनयच्चापि पुत्रान् पञ्चशतं पुनः। संहारान् नाम दुर्धर्षान् दुराक्रमान् बलीयसः॥
en: Suprabhā also brought forth fifty sons named Sanhäras, incapable of being borne, and infallible and powerful.

sa: तथा वसिष्ठे ब्रुवति राजा दशरथः स्वयम्। प्रहृष्टवदनो राममाजुहाव सलक्ष्मणम्॥
en: Upon Vasistha's representing this, king Dasaratha himself, with complacent countenance, summoned to him Rāma and Laksmana.

sa: दुहिता मेरुसावर्णेरहं तस्याः स्वयंप्रभा॥ इदं रक्षामि भवनं हेमाया वानरोत्तम।
en: I, Svayamprabhā by name,-the daughter of Merusāvarņi, guard this house of Hemā, O foremost of monkeys.

sa: करिष्यति स साहाय्यं युवयोर्भास्करात्मजः। सुग्रीवः सह चास्माभिः सीतायाः परिमार्गणे॥
en: That son of the Sun, Sugriva, along with us, will help you in seeking out Sītā.

sa: अथ पद्मपलाशाक्षीं मैथिलीमनु चिन्तयन्। उवाच लक्ष्मणं रामो मुखेन परिशुष्यता॥
en: Thereupon thinking of Maithelee, having eyes resembling lotus-petals, Rāma spoke to Laks mana with dried countenance.

sa: सोऽङ्गदेन तदा वीरः प्रत्युक्तः प्लवगर्षभः। जाम्बवानुत्तमं वाक्यं प्रोवाचेदं ततोऽङ्गदम्॥
en: Thus addressed by Angada that powerful and heroic monkey Jāmbavān answered Angada in excellent words, saying,

sa: स्वर्गलोकं गतं दृष्ट्वा त्रिशङ्ख पाकशासनः॥ सह सर्वैः सुरगणैरिदं वचनमब्रबीत्।
en: And beholding Trisanku risen to heaven, the subduer of Indra, together with all the celestial said.

sa: तेषां मध्ये विशालाक्षी कौशेयं कनकप्रभम्। उत्तरीयं वरारोहा शुभान्याभरणानि च॥ मुमोच यदि रामाय शंसेयुरिति भामिनी। वस्रमुत्सृज्य तन्मध्ये निक्षिप्तं सहभूषणम्॥
en: Thereat, that lady of expansive eyes and surpassing charms, in the hope that they might convey the intelligence to Rāma, flung off in their midst her gold-gleaming silken sheet, and elegant ornaments.

sa: कर्णवन्ति हि भूतानि विशेषेण तुरङ्गमाः। यूयं तस्मानिवर्तभ्वं याचना प्रतिवेदिताः॥
en: And more pareicularly being creatures furnished with ears, do you, your horses, knowing our prayer, desist.

sa: अनुरक्ता महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्। अनुजग्मुः प्रयान्तं तं वनवासाय मानवाः॥
en: The people, who yarned after Rāma having truth for prowess, followed him repairing to the forest.

sa: इत्येवं भरतं वीक्ष्य विलपन्तमचेतनम्। कृपणा रुरुदुः सर्वाः सुस्वरं योषितस्तदा॥
en: Seeing Bharata lamenting thus senseless, the ladies afflicted with sorrow began to wail in winsome accents.

sa: विकुण्ठनः खलु दाशार्हामुपयेमे सुदेवां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अजमीढो नाम॥
en: Vikunthana married Sudeva, the princess of Dasarha and she gave birth to a son, named Ajamidha.

sa: चिन्तयन् स महाप्राज्ञश्चकार मतिमान्मतिम्। शिष्यं चैवाब्रवीद् वाक्यमिदं स मुनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Resolving thus in his mind, that highly-wise one and best of sages addressed his disciple, saying.

sa: ततस्तत्र प्रविष्टस्य कौसल्याया निवेशनम्। अधिरुह्यापि शयनं बभूव लुलितं मनः॥
en: Having entered Kausalyā's apartment, the king having laid himself on the bed, was overwhelmed with emotion.

sa: ते हास्तिनपुरे गङ्गां तीर्त्वा प्रत्यङ्मुखा ययुः। पाञ्चालदेशमासाद्य मध्येन कुरुजाङ्गलम्॥
en: Then crossing the Gangā at Hastināpura, and arriving at Pāñcāla, they proceeded west ward through Kurujāngala.

sa: प्रसुस्रवुः शकृन्मूत्रं वाहनानि च सर्वशः। एवं सवाहनं सर्वमाविग्नमभवद् बलम्॥
en: All the beasts discharged urine and excreta. Your whole army with its animals seized with anxiety.

sa: एवमुक्तः स राजर्षिस्तव पूर्वपितामहः। जगाम सह धर्मेण सर्वेश्च त्रिदिवालयैः॥
en: Thus addressed the royal sage, viz., your grandsire, proceeded with Dharma and all the other celestials.

sa: यदेको बहुभिः सार्धमसम्भ्रान्तमयुध्यत। अवधीच रथानीकं द्विरदानां च तद् बलम्॥
en: He then continually went on slaying the divisions of car-warriors elephants and horsemen and the robbers.

sa: न च तत् कृतवान् राजा यथा ख्यातं हि तत् पुरा॥ अनवाप्य शमं तज्ञ कृष्णः पुरुषसत्तमः। आगच्छत महाबाहुरुपप्लव्यं जनाधिप॥
en: The king, however, as I have told you before did not pay heed to his advice. Unable to secure peace, the mighty-armed Krishna, The foremost of men, returned, O king, to Upaplavya.

sa: मनसस्तु समुद्भूता महाभूता नराधिप। चतुर्थं सर्गमित्येतन्मानसं विद्धि मे मतम्॥
en: From Mind have originated the great elements, O king! This is the fourth creation called mental.

sa: दीप्यमानं ततो वह्नि पुष्पैरभ्यर्च्य सत्कृतम्॥ तयोर्मध्ये तु सुप्रीतो निदधौ सुसमाहितः। ततोऽग्निं दीप्यमानं तौ चक्रतुश्च प्रदक्षिणम्॥ सुग्रीवो राघवश्चैव वयस्यत्वमुपागतौ।
en: Then worshipping that flaming fire with flowers, he, well pleased, carefully placed it between them (Rāma and Sugrīva). Then Sugrīva and Rāghava went round the fire; and (thus) were fastened in friendship.

sa: कृतवर्मा तु समरे पार्षतेन दृढाहतः। पार्षतं सरथं छादयामास सायकैः॥
en: Thus Assailed by a Parohata in battle Kritavarma covered him, his chariot and horses with arrows.

sa: अपूजयन् महात्मानो ब्राह्मणास्तं महाबलम्। इदमाहुस्तदा चैव स्कन्दं तत्र महर्षयः॥
en: The high-souled Brahmanas worshipped that greatly powerful one and the great Rishis spoke thus to Skanda.

sa: यजुषामृचां साम्नां च गद्यानां चैव सर्वशः। आसीदुच्चार्यमाणानां नि:स्वनो हृदयङ्गमः॥
en: The sounds of Yajus, Riks, Saman and other words uttered by the Brahmanas, were exceedingly charming.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं ततो यान्तं शारद्वतरथं प्रति। प्रतिजग्राह वेगेन कृतवर्मा महारथः॥
en: Thereupon the mighty car-warrior Kritavarma vehemently resisted Dhristadyumna who was advancing towards the son of Sharadvata.

sa: अथ तं स्नायुपाशेन बद्ध्वा सर्पममर्षितः। लुब्धकोऽर्जुनको नाम गौतम्याः समुपानयत्॥
en: An angry fowler, named Arjunaka, bound the serpent with a string and brought it before Gautami.

sa: एवमुक्तस्ततो देवान् प्राह वाक्यं प्रजापतिः। नैतच्छक्यं मम वचो व्यावर्तयितुमन्यथा॥
en: Thus addressed, Daksha, that Lord of creatures, said:-"It is impossible to make my words prove otherwise.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु देवेन्द्रमुवाच परिशङ्किता। कथं जानामि देवेन्द्रं त्वामिहस्थं खजापतिम्॥
en: Thus addressed, Sītā, alarmed, said, How can I know you for Devendra, Saci's husband, staying here?

sa: तस्मिन् बिल्वाः कपित्थाश्च पनसा बीजपूरकाः। आमलक्यो बभूवुश्च चूताश्च फलभूषिताः॥
en: And on it stood Bilvas, and Kapitthas, Panasas, citrons, and Amalakas, and mangoes, embellished with fruits.

sa: तत: स स्तम्भितभुजः शक्रो देवगणैर्वृतः॥ जगाम ससुरस्तूर्णं ब्रह्माणं प्रभुमव्ययम्।
en: Then with his arm paralysed Shakra, surrounded by the celestials, quickly proceeded to the undeteriorating Brahma.

sa: गजो गवाक्षो गवयो नलो नीलश्च वानरः॥ एकैकमेव योधानां कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतः।
en: Gaya, Gavākşa, Nala, and the monkey Nīlaeach of these is encompassed by ten koțis of warriors.

sa: इति ते नानुशिष्टस्तु वाचं मन्दमुदीरयन्। तदा राक्षसशार्दूलं शार्दूलो भयविक्लवः॥
en: Thus ordered by him, then (Sārdula), bewildered by fear, addressed that tiger of a Raksasa, saying.

sa: क्षत्रियाणां सहान्योन्यं संयुगे जयमिच्छताम्। प्राद्रवन्नेव सम्भग्नाः पाण्डवैस्तव सैनिकाः॥ त्यक्त्वा युद्धे प्रियान् पुत्रान् भ्रातृनथ पितामहान्। मातुलान् भागिनेयांश्च वयस्यानपि भारत॥
en: Despite it, your troops routed by the Pandavas, fled away leaving behind on the field, their dear sons and brothers and maternal uncles and sisters and relatives by marriage and other kinsmen.

sa: पुत्रो दशरथस्यैष सिंहसंहननो युवा। दूषणो निहतो येन स्वरश्च त्रिशिरास्तथा॥
en: And this is Dasaratha's son—this you resembling a lion, who slew Düşana and Khara and Triſiras.

sa: सुचन्द्रतनयो राम धूम्राश्व इति विश्रुतः। धूम्राश्वतनयश्चापि सृञ्जयः समपद्यत ॥
en: O Rāma, the son of Sucandra was Dhumrāśva, and then was born Sšñjaya son to Dhumrāśva.

sa: आदित्यकेतुः सप्तत्या बह्वाशी चापि पञ्चभिः। नवत्या कुण्डधारच विशालाक्षश्च पञ्चभिः॥
en: Adityaketu pierced Bhima with seventy shafts, Bahvashin with five, Kundadhara with ninety and Vishalaksha with seven.

sa: ततः शापभयाद् विप्रमवोचं पुनरेव तम्। एवमस्त्विति च प्राह पुनरेव स मे द्विजः॥ धर्मस्य जननी भद्रे भवित्री त्वं शुभानने। वशे स्थास्यन्ति ते देवा यांस्त्वमावाहयिष्यसि॥
en: Fearing his curse, I answered him saying, 'So be it.' The Rishi once more said to me, '0 blessed damsel, O you of beautiful face, you will become the mother of Dharma. Those deities whom you will summon will obey you,

sa: उष्णात् परः प्रावरकः प्रावारादन्धकारकः। अन्धकारकदेशात् तु मुनिदेशः परः स्मृतः॥
en: Next to Ushna is Pravaraka, next to Pravarka is Andhakaraka, next to Andhakaraka is named Munidesha,

sa: अपि जीवेद् दशरथो वनवासात् पुनर्वयम्। प्रत्यागम्य महात्मानमपि पश्याम सुव्रतम्॥
en: If Dasaratha live we shall returning from the forest, behold that high-souled one observing noble vows.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु कैकेय्या राजा दशरथस्तदा। प्रत्युवाच ततः क्रुद्धो मुहूर्तं विह्वलनिव॥
en: Thus addressed by Kaikeyi king Dasaratha, remaining stupefied for a while thus answered her in wrath.

sa: ततो वैतालिकैः सूतैर्मागधैश्च सुभाषितैः। स्तूयमानो ययौ राजा नगरं नागसाह्वयम्॥
en: His praises sung by sweet-voiced panegyrists and birds, the king went towards the city of Hastinapur.

sa: केशवे तु तदा याते धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। विसृज्य सर्वान् भ्रातूंश्च पञ्चालानथ सोमकान्॥ सुष्वाप रजनीं तां तु विशल्य इव कुञ्जरः।
en: After Keshava had departed the righteous king Yudhishthira, sending away all his brothers and the Somakas, happily slept that night, like an elephant from whose body the darts have been plucked out.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नमहत्वा तु नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥ स मे पितुर्वधाद् वध्यः पञ्चाला ये च संगताः। विलापो भग्नसक्थस्य यस्तु राज्ञो मया श्रुतः॥
en: was I cannot bear the thought of maintaining life without having killed Dhristadyumna in battle! For the slaughter of my father, he and those who are with him should be killed me.

sa: अत्र गाथां यज्ञगीतां कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। त्रयीमुपाश्रितां लोके यज्ञ संस्तरकारिकाम्॥
en: Regarding it certain verses relating to Sacrifices are recited by persons well read in ancient scriptures.

sa: हत्वा तत् पुरुषानीकं भीमः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं पुरस्कृत्य नचिरात् प्रत्यदृश्यत।
en: Having killed that strong army 3hima, of great prowess, showed himself with Dhrishtadyumna in his front.

sa: तस्य तौ भ्रातरौ राजशरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ रथं विशकलीकर्तुं समारब्धौ विशाम्पते।
en: Then those two brothers, O kings, with their straight arrows, cut off Nakula's car into pieces.

sa: नारदेन च भद्रं ते पूर्वमेव न संशयः। युधिष्ठिरस्य समितौ राजसूये निवेदितम्॥ पाण्डवाः कौरवाः सर्वे समासाद्य परस्परम्। न भविष्यन्ति कौन्तेय यत् ते कृत्यं तदाचर॥
en: Narada had truly spoken out to Yudhishthira, all this in his court at the time of the Rajasuya sacrifice, saying, "The Pandavas and the Kauravas, meeting which each other, will be destroyed. Do that, O son of Kunti, which you should.

sa: अनुवर्तामहे यत्तु तं वयं पापपूरुषम्॥ अस्मानप्यनयस्तस्मात् प्राप्तोऽयं दारुणो महान्।
en: Regarding ourselves, since we have followed that sinful wretch, this great calamity has, therefore befallen us.

sa: तावन्योन्यं समाभाष्य एकतश्च द्वितश्च ह॥ यदूचतुर्मिथः पापौ तन्निबोध जनेश्वर।
en: Hear, O king, what those two sinful wretches, viz., Ekata and Dvita, said to each other.

sa: दुर्योधनो धनुश्छित्त्वा धृष्टद्युम्नस्य संयुगे॥ अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं विव्याध निशितैः शरैः।
en: Having cut off Dhrishtadyumna's bow in that battle, Dhrishtadyumna struck his bowless antagonist with kcen arrows.

sa: ततः सुमनसः पार्था भीमसेनमपूजयन्। ते दृष्टा कर्म संग्रामे घोरमकिष्टकर्मणः॥
en: Beholding that terrible fear of his in battle, the Parthas joyfully worshipped Bhima of untiring energy.

sa: जानासि च महाबाहो धर्मराजस्य या त्वयि॥ भक्तिर्भरतशार्दूल स्नेहश्चापि स्वभावतः।
en: You know, O mighty armed one, the devotion of king Yudhisthira and his affection towards you.

sa: तं सर्वदैतेया राक्षसाः दानवास्तथा। व्यद्रवन्त दिशः सर्वा भयोद्विग्नाः समन्ततः॥
en: Beholding him, all the Daityas and Rakshasas and Danavas, overcome with fear, dispersed in all directions.

sa: पुण्याभ्यश्च सरिद्रयस्त्वं सदा पुण्यतमा शुभे॥ भविष्यसि महाभागे मत्प्रसादात् सरस्वति।
en: O blessed Sarasvati, through my grace, thou shalt always become the best of all sacred rivers!'

sa: सलोकतामनुप्राप्तमपश्यत ततोऽसितः। रुद्राणां च वसूनां च स्थानं यच्च बृहस्पतेः॥
en: Asita then saw his guest go through the regions of the Rudras, the Vasus and Brihaspati.

sa: अनतिक्रमणीयो हि धर्मराजस्य केशवः। बाल्यात् प्रभृति गोविन्दः प्रीत्या चाभ्यधिकोऽर्जुनात्॥
en: Yudhishthira could never disobey Keshava. From his infancy Govinda was dearer to Yudhishthira than Arjuna himself.

sa: तत्र विक्रोशमानानां रुदतीनां च सर्वशः॥ प्रादुरासीन्महाशब्दः श्रुत्वा तद् बलसंक्षयम्।
en: The attendants and ladies wept aloud when they heard of the destruction of the whole army.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रोऽपि धर्मात्मा स्वस्थचेता महामनाः। स्वमेव नगरं राजन् प्रतिपेदे महर्द्धिमत्॥
en: The liberal and righteous king Dhrutarashtra, with a cheerful heart, returned to his own prosperous capital.

sa: अग्रसत् तांस्तथाभूतं द्रौणिना प्रहिताशरान्। अश्वत्थामा तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य शरौघांस्तान् निरर्थकान्॥
en: Seeing his arrowy showers prove fruitless, Ashvathaman discharged at him a long dart burning like fire.

sa: अरुणस्ताम्रचूडं च प्रददौ चरणायुधम्॥ नागं तु वरुणो राजा बलवीर्यसमन्वितम्।
en: Aruna gave him a cock of sharp talons, The royal Varuna gave him a powerful shake.

sa: सदण्डशूला दीप्तायाः शीर्यमाणाः समन्ततः। उल्का भूमिं दिवः पेतुराहत्य रविमण्डलम्॥
en: Meteors, keen pointed and bright like lances, dropped on Earth from the sky piercing the air.

sa: प्रतिज्ञानं ह्यविज्ञानं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥ यदारभ्य क्रियां काञ्चिद् भयादिह निवर्तते।
en: The wise describe defeat as foolishness when one having undertaken a task abandons it from fear.

sa: ते हि नित्यं महाराज भीमसेनस्य लुब्धकाः। मांसभारानुपाजहुर्भक्त्या परमया विभो॥
en: Those hunters, O king, used, every day, to procure basketfuls of meat for Bhimasena, O king.

sa: अपरे पुनरालिङ्गय गदाः परिघबाहवः। शेरतेऽभिमुखाः शूरा दयिता इव योषितः॥
en: Some with massive arms, are sleeping with maces under them as if those were beloved wives.

sa: संविनीय मदक्रोधौ मानमर्त्यां च निवृताः। नित्यं पञ्चोपधातीतैर्मन्त्रयेत् सह मन्त्रिभिः॥
en: A king should also consult such minister as are free from the five kinds of deceit.

sa: समन्ततः प्रमुदितान् ददर्श सुमनोहरान्। क्वचिदप्सरसा संघान् गन्धर्वाणां च पार्थिव॥
en: Here and there he saw bevies of rejoicing Apsaras and conclaves of happy Gandharva, O monarch.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तु पुत्रेण तदा वानरकेतनः। स्मयन् प्रोवाच कौन्तेयस्तदा चित्राङ्गदासुतम्॥ विदितं ते महाबाहो यथा दीक्षां चराम्यहम्। न स तावत् प्रवेक्ष्यामि पुरं ते पृथुलोचन॥
en: The ape-bannered son of Kunti, thus addressed by his son, answered the child Chitrangada, saying, You know, mighty-armed one, what vow I am observing? O you of large eyes, till the termination of this my vow, I cannot enter your city.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा दीनमनसं गतसत्त्वं नरेश्वरम्। भूयः शोकसमाविष्टाः पाण्डवाः समुपाविशन्॥
en: And seeing the king despondent and feeble, the Pandavas, over-laden with grief, sat down surrounding him.

sa: अन्तःपुरेषु च तदा सुमहान् रुदितस्वनः। प्रादुरासीन्महाराज पृथां श्रुत्वा तथागताम्॥
en: Hearing that Pritha had met with such a face, the royal ladies bewailed aloud in grief.

sa: वासांसि च महार्हाणि माल्यानि विविधानि च। उपाजह्वर्यथान्यायं धृतराष्ट्रस्य पाण्डवाः॥
en: Pandu's son collected costly dresses and garlands of various kinds and duly offered them to Dhritarashtra.

sa: य इच्छेत् पुरुषोऽत्यन्तमात्मानं निरुपद्रवम्। स वर्जयेत मांसानि प्राणिनामिह सर्वशः॥
en: That man who wishes to avoid disaster should abstain from the meat of every living creature.

sa: तामाबभाषे देवेन्द्रः साम्ना परमवल्गुना। त्वदर्थमागतं विद्धि देवेन्द्रं मां शुचिस्मिते॥
en: The king of the celestials then addressed her in sweet words uttered with a sweet voice.

sa: मनुरुवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। शुक्रस्य च बलेश्चैव संवादं वै महात्मनोः॥
en: Manu said Regarding it is recited the oid discourse between Shukra and the great (Daitya) Bali.

sa: स च राजा महातेजाः पूजितो बभ्रुवाहनः॥ धृतराष्ट्रं महीपालमुपतस्थे यथाविधि।
en: King Babhruvahana of great energy, duly honored (by Kunti), then inet Dhritarashtra according to due rites.

sa: धर्मः कामश्च कालश्च वसुर्वासुकिरेव च। अनन्तः कपिलश्चैव सप्तैते धरणीधराः॥
en: Dharma, Kama, Kala, Vasu, Vasuki, Ananta, and Kapila, these seven are the upholders of the world.

sa: गौतमस्य तु शिष्याणां बहूनां जनमेजय। उत्तङ्केऽभ्यधिका प्रीतिः स्नेहश्चैवाभवत् तदा॥
en: Gautama's gratification with and affection for Utanka, among his numberless disciples, were every great, O Janamejaya.

sa: एवं स राजशार्दूल नृपः शान्तनवस्तदा॥ समयुज्यत कालेन भरतानां कुलोद्वहः।
en: O great king, thus did Shantanu's son, that pillar of Bharata's race, unite himself with eternity.

sa: द्वारकावासिनो ये तु पुरुषाः पार्थमभ्ययुः। यथार्ह संविभज्यैनान् वजे पर्यददज्जयः॥
en: Those men who had followed Arjuna from Dvaravati, were divided into groups, and bestowed upon Vajra.

sa: स तैः परिवृतो राजा कथाभिः परिनन्ध तान्। अनुजज्ञे सशिष्यान् वै विधिवत् प्रतिपूज्य च॥
en: Silting in their midst, he plcased them all by his words. Having duly adored the Brahmanas with their disciples, he disinissed them all.

sa: गौतम उवाच यत्र शीतभयं नास्ति न चोष्णभयमण्वपि। न क्षुत्पिपासे न ग्लानिर्न दुःखं न सुखं तथा॥ न द्वेष्यो न प्रियः कश्चिन्न बन्धुर्न रिपुस्तथा। न जरामरणे तत्र न पुण्यं न च पातकम्॥
en: Gautama said Next to these are regions where there is no fear of the least cold or heat, no hunger, no thirst, no pain, no sorrow, no joy, no one who is agreeable or disagreeable, no friend, and no enemy, no decrepitude and no death, and where there is neither virtue nor sin.

sa: न क्रोधो न च मात्सर्यं न लोभो नाशुभा मतिः। भवन्ति कृतपुण्यानां भक्तानां पुरुषोत्तमे॥
en: Neither anger, nor jealousy, nor cupidity, nor evil understanding, ever appears in those virtuous men who are devoted to that foremost of Beings.

sa: ततो ब्रह्मा तु गाः प्रायमुपविष्टाः समीक्ष्य ह। ईप्सितं प्रददौ ताभ्यो गोभ्यः प्रत्येकशः प्रभुः॥
en: Seeing the kine paying their adorations to him and sitting without food, the powerful Brahman granted to each of them what each desired.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच तस्मिन्नन्तर्हिते विप्रे राजा किमकरोत् तदा। भार्या चास्य महाभागा तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said After the Rishi had disappeared, what did the king do and what also his highly-blessed wife? Tell me this O grandfather.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अथ दृष्ट्वा परिव्राट् स तान् महर्षीन् शुना सह। अभिगम्य यथान्यायं पाणिस्पर्शमथाचरत्॥
en: Bhishma said Seeing those great Rishis, the wandering mendicant, approached them and accosted them all by touching their hand, according to the practice.

sa: यज्ञाझं कथिता गावो यज्ञ एव च वासव। एताभिश्च विना यज्ञो न वर्तेत कथंचन॥
en: Kine have been said to be the limbs of sacrifice. They represent sacrifice itself, O Vasava! Without them there can be no sacrifice.

sa: तेजसा वपुषा चैव गावो वह्निसमा भुवि। गावो हि सुमहत् तेजः प्राणिनां च सुखप्रदाः॥
en: On Earth, kine resemble fire in energy and form. Indeed, kine represent high energy, and are conferreres of great happiness upon all creatures.

sa: वृद्धौ हि तेऽद्य पितरौ पश्य नौ दुःखितौ नृप। न शोचितव्यं भवता पश्यामीह जनाधिप।॥
en: See your old father and mother, O king, plunged in misery. But, O master of men, I find no reason for your sorrow.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आख्यातं मे भगवता गर्भः संजायते यथा। यथा जातस्तु पुरुषः प्रपद्यति तदुच्यताम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have, O illustrious one, said how conception takes piace. Do you explain how the individual soul that takes birth, grows.

sa: तेनैव हि भवेयुस्ते लोकाः पापकृतो यथा। कृत्वा नाचक्षत: कर्म मम यच्च त्वया कृतम्॥
en: For this reason you will visit the regions that are reserved for the sinful. You did not tell me what you had done.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच इमे वै मानवा लोके नृशंसा मांसगृद्धिनः। विसृज्य विविधान् भक्ष्यान् महारक्षोगणा इव॥
en: Yudhishthira said Alas, those cruel men, who not caring for various other sorts of food, want only flesh, are really like great Rakshasa.

sa: कथं च वर्तते चाद्य पिता मम स पार्थिवः। श्रोतुमिच्छामि भगवन् यदि दृष्टस्त्वया नृपः॥
en: How, indeed, is that royal sire of mine doing? I wish to hear this, O holy one, if you have seen the king.

sa: और्व उवाच उक्तवानस्मि यां क्रोधात् प्रतिज्ञां पितरस्तदा। सर्वलोकविनाशाय न सा मे वितथा भवेत्॥
en: Arjuna said : O Pitris, the vow I uttered in anger for the destruction of all the worlds must not be in vain.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्ततो राज्ञा प्रसादमकरोन्मुनिः। कृतप्रसादं राजा तं ततः समवतारयत्॥ अवतार्य च शूलाग्रात् तच्छूलं निश्चकर्ष ह। अशक्नुवंश्च निष्क्रष्टुं शूलं मूले च चिच्छिदे॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by the king, the Rishi was gratified. Having thus gratified him, the king took down the Shula and tried to draw it out from him but he was unable to do it.

sa: असत्कारः स तु महान् मुहूर्तमपि तस्य तु। नापैति हृदयाद् राज्ञो दुर्मनाः स कृशोऽभवत्॥
en: The thought of that humiliation didnot (however) leave the king's mind for a single moment. Being miserable in mind, the king wasted away.

sa: ततोऽहं न करोम्येनं व्यवसायं क्रियां प्रति। धर्मः सदैव संदिग्धः प्रतिभाति हि मे त्वयम्॥
en: I can therefore never make up my mind to act in this way. The practice appears to me to be of doubtful morality.

sa: यतो हि निम्नं भवति नयन्ति हि ततो जलम्। यतश्छिद्रं ततश्चापि नयन्ते धीवरा जलम्॥
en: The wise always conduct the water to place that are low. The fisherman take the water through the place where there are holes.

sa: त्वं हि तीव्रण तपसा प्रजास्तापयसेऽनघ। ब्रूहि कामं च मे शेष यस्ते हृदि व्यवस्थितः॥
en: O sinless one, you are giving pain to all creatures by your austere penances. O Shesha, tell me the desire of your mind."

sa: तं राजसूयं सुहृदः कार्यमाहुः समेत्य मे। तत्र मे निश्चिततमं तव कृष्ण गिरा भवेत्॥
en: O Krishna, my friends and ministers have said that I should perform it, but your words will be my guide in this matter.

sa: सौतिरुवाच ततो निवेशाय तदा स विप्रः संशितव्रतः। महीं चचार दारार्थी न च दारानविन्दतः॥
en: Sauti said : The Brahmana of hard austerities (Jaratkaru) roamed over the world for a wife, but he did not get a wife.

sa: स कर्ण इति विख्यातः पृथायाः प्रथमः सुतः। स तु सूतकुले वीरो ववृधे राजसत्तम॥
en: He, the eldest son of Pritha, was called Karna. O best of kings, he thus began to grow up in the Suta caste.

sa: तौ स राजा जरासंधः श्रुत्वा च निधनं गतौ। पुरं शून्येन मनसा प्रययौ भरतर्षभ॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, when Jarasandha heard of the death of the two heroes, he returned to his city with an empty heart.

sa: यदाश्रौषं द्रोणपुत्रं च शूरं दुःशासनं कृतवर्माणमुग्रम्। युधिष्ठरं धर्मराजं जयन्तं तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Yudhishthira had defeated the son of Drona, Dushasana and fearful Kritavarma.

sa: यत्र कौमारमाख्यानमभिषेकस्य कर्म च। वृत्तानि स्थयुद्धानि कीर्त्यन्ते यत्र भागशः। विनाशः कुरुमुख्यानां शल्यपर्वणि कीर्त्यते॥
en: Then is described one after the other the encounters of various charioteer; then the deaths of the chief warrior of the Kuru army.

sa: पितामह उवाच यत् प्रार्थितं यथोक्तं च काममेतद् ददानि वाम्। मृत्योर्विधानमेतच्च यथावद् वा भविष्यति॥
en: The Grandsire said : I great you what you have asked, said and desired. Your death is fixed according to your own desire.

sa: न मां त्वमवजानीषे दुःखितामवमानिताम्। वृक्षस्यावज्ञया ब्रह्मश्छिद्यन्ते वृक्षजीविनः॥ अवज्ञया च राजर्षिः परिभूय च भार्गव। मय्यवज्ञां प्रयुङ्क्ते हि न च मां बहु मन्यते ॥
en: You do not know of the miseries and insults I have been subject to. O Brāhmaṇa, when a tree is neglected, those who live thereon are also distressed. The king having disregarded me, forsooth you have also been neglected.

sa: प्रतीप उवाच नाहं परस्त्रियं कामाद् गच्छेयं वरवर्णिनी। न चासवर्णा कल्याणि धर्म्यमेतद्धि मे व्रतम्॥
en: Pratipa said: O beautiful lady, I never go to another man's wife out of lust. O fortunate maiden, this is my solemn vow.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा पाण्डवः क्रुद्धो गन्धर्वाय मुमोच ह। प्रदीप्तमस्त्रमाग्नेयं ददाहास्य रथं तु तत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this, the Pandava (Arjuna) angrily hurled at the Gandharva that blazing fire weapon which immediately brunt his chariot.

sa: अतोऽन्यथा चेत् क्रियते यद् ब्रवीमि परं हितम्। कुरवो वै विनक्षयन्ति नचिरेणैव मे मतिः॥
en: If the advice, productive of great good that I have given, is not followed, my opinion is that the Kurus will be exterminated.

sa: ममापि दयितो रामो जीवितादपि लक्ष्मण। न चाहमेवं शोचामि मैवं त्वं बालिशो भव ॥
en: O Lakşmaņa! Rāma is also dearer than my life, but I am not so sorry— do you not be therefore overwhelmed with grief.

sa: बलाबलं विनिश्चित्य तप एव परं बलम्। स राज्यं स्फीतमुत्सृज्यां तां च दीप्तां नृपश्रियम्॥
en: In judging of strength and weakness, I see asceticism is true strength.” Thereupon that best of kings abandoning his kingdom and regal splendour,

sa: शप्तोऽहं वेदवत्या च यथा सा धर्षिता पुरा ॥ सेयं सीता महाभागा जाता जनकनन्दिनी।
en: I was also cursed by Vedavatī, who was formerly outraged by me. And she is (perchance) born as the exalted daughter of Janaka.

sa: त्वया ह्यनुक्तैर्हरिभि व शक्यं पदात् पदम्। क्वचिद् गन्तुं हरिश्रेष्ठ ब्रूमः सत्यमिदं तु ते॥
en: Verily we speak to you, O foremost of monkeys, that without your permission, none among us, is capable of advancing a single step.”

sa: तेषां सुभीमस्तुमुलो निनादो बभूव शाखामृगयूथपानाम्। क्षये निदाघस्य यथा घनानां नादः सुभीमो नदतां निशीथे॥
en: That mighty and dreadful din raised by the monkeys, resembled the terrible rumbling of the clouds at midnight about the end of Summer.

sa: निवर्तय रथं शीघ्रं यावत्रापैति मे रिपुः। यदि वाध्युषितोऽसि त्वं स्मर्यते यदि मे गुणः॥
en: If you have been maintained by me, if you remember my merit, do you swiftly turn the car before my enemy has departed.

sa: यथा मां शुद्धचारित्रां दुष्टां जानाति राघवः। तथा लोकस्य साक्षी मां सर्वतः पातु पावकः॥
en: As Rāghava consider me vile, who have got a pure character, may fire, the witness of the people, protect me on all sides.

sa: अद्यैनं तावुभौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ प्रव्यथिष्यतः। लोकपाला हि चत्वारः क्रुद्धेनानेन निर्जिताः।। बहवः शत्रवश्चान्ये संयुगेष्वभिपातिताः॥
en: By this one influenced with passion were the four guardians of the worlds conquered; and many other foes were brought down in battle.

sa: लोकेभ्यो यानि रत्नानि सम्प्रमथ्याहृतानि मे। तानि ते भीरु सर्वाणि राज्यं चैव ददामि ते॥
en: O timid one, all the jewels that I have collected from the three worlds, and all my kingdom I shall confer on you.

sa: नेयमस्ति पुरी लङ्का न यूयं न च रावणः। यस्य त्विक्ष्वाकुवीरेण बद्धं वैरं महात्मना॥
en: Neither this city of Lanka, nor you, nor yet Rāvaņa, shall exist, having created hostility with that high-souled hero of the Ikşvāku race.

sa: एवं तेषां निवसतां मासः साग्रो ययौ तदा। मुहूर्तमिव ते सर्वे रामभक्त्या च मेनिरे॥
en: In this way they spent more than a month—but it appeared to them as a moment on account of their devotion to Rāma.

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतं प्राह देवः पितामहः। शतक्रतो किमु पुरा करोति स्म सुदुष्कृतम्॥
en: Beholding him in that plight the grand-father of the deities said:-O performer of hundred sacrifices, why did you formerly perpetrate that mighty iniquity?

sa: देवान्तको वापि नरान्तको वा तथातिकायोऽतिरथो महात्मा। अकम्पनश्चापि समानसारः स्थातुं न शक्ता युधि राघवस्य॥
en: And neither Devāntaka nor Narāntaka, neither Atikāya, nor the magnanimous Atiratha, nor the equally strong Akampana, is competent to stay Rāghava in fight.

sa: न मे दुःखं प्रिया दूरे न मे दुःखं हृतेति च। एतदेवानुशोचामि वयोऽस्या ह्यतिवर्तते॥
en: I am not sorry that she has been stealthily taken away by the demon-but my sorrow is that her end is drawing high.

sa: हत्वा तु समरे रक्षो रावणं सहबान्धवैः। राघवौ त्वां विशालाक्षि स्वां पुरी प्रति नेष्यतः॥
en: O you of expansive eyes, slaying in battle Rāvana along with his friends, Raghu's, sons shall take you back to their own palace.

sa: मण्डलानि विचित्राणि स्थानानि विविधानि च। गोमूत्रकाणि चित्राणि गतप्रत्यागतानि च॥ तिरश्चीनगतान्येव तथा वक्रगतानि च। परिमोक्षं प्रहाराणां वर्जनं परिधावनम्॥ अभिद्रवणमाप्लावमवस्थानं सविग्रहम्। परावृत्तमपावृत्तमपद्रुतमवप्लुतम्॥ उपन्यस्तमपन्यस्तं युद्धमार्गविशारदौ। तौ विचेरतुरन्योन्यं वानरेन्द्रश्च रावणः॥
en: The lord of monkeys and Ravana, accomplished in fight, coursed the arena, displaying wonderful Mandalas, various sthānas, (a) curious gomutrakas, (b) gatapratyagatas, tirascinagatas, Vakragatas, parimoksas, varjanas, paridhāvanas, abhidravaņas, (c) aplavanas (d) savigrahāvasthānas, (e) paravrttas, (1) apavrttas, (g) apadrutas, (h) avaplutas, (i) apanyastas, (j) and upanyastas (k).

sa: उद्धृष्टं वानराणां च राक्षसानां च निःस्वनम्। दिशो दश समुद्रं च पृथिवीं च व्यनादयत्॥
en: The shouts of the monkeys and the cries of the Rākşasas made the ten cardinal quarters and the ocean and the Earth resound.

sa: क एषां पूर्वको ब्रह्मन्किनामा च बलोत्कटः। अपराधं च कं प्राप्य विष्णुना द्राविताः कथम्॥
en: Who was their progenitor? And what was the name of that terrific strength? And through what transgression were they driven out by Vişnu?

sa: भवतां प्रीतिरव्यग्रा तेजसा परिरक्षिता।२१।। धर्मश्च नियतो नित्यं सत्यं च भवतां सदा। युष्माकं चानुभावेन तेजसा च महात्मनाम्॥ हतो दुरात्मा दुर्बुद्धी रावणो राक्षसाधमः। हेतुमात्रमहं तत्र भवतां तेजसा हतः॥
en: Being well protected by your own prowess, you have all displayed your great love for me. By your piety, truthfulness, sagacity and strength, the vicious-souled Rāvana has been slain. Forsooth, I am merely the instrument in the destruction of Rāvana-he has been slain by your strength.

sa: यथा मां शुद्धचारित्रां दुष्टां जानाति राघवः। तथा लोकस्य साक्षी मां सर्वतः पातु पावकः॥
en: As Rāghava consider me vile, who have got a pure character, may fire, the witness of the people, protect me on all sides.

sa: हत्वा च समरक्रूरं रावणं सहबान्धवम्। राघवस्त्वां विशालाक्षि त्वां पुरी प्रति नेष्यति । ५१।।
en: And, O you of expansive eyes, slaying in battle the wicked Rāvana with his allies, Rághava shall take you back to his palace.

sa: यदि दृष्टं बलं सर्वं वयं वा सुसमाहिताः। यथोक्तं वा कृतं कार्यं छन्दतः प्रतिगम्यताम्॥
en: If you have heedfully noted this entire array, or if you have done what you had been commanded to do, return in peace.

sa: स यथैवागतः पूर्वं तथैव त्वरितं गतः। निपत्य गगनाद् भूमौ तद् वनं प्रविवेश ह॥
en: He went away with the same speed with which he came and leaping down on the earth from the sky, entered the orchard.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्राह्मणस्वानि ये मन्दा हरन्ति भरतर्षभ। नृशंसकारिणो मूढाः क्व ते गच्छन्ति मानवाः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Where do those foolish, wretched, and sinful men go, O king, who steal misappropriate such articles as belong to Brahmanas? or

sa: शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसञ्चापि गुणा: स्मृताः। रसज्ञानं तु वक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृण॥
en: Sound, touch, vision and taste are the properties of water. I shall describe fully that now the perception of taste. Listen to me.

sa: तैश्च यत् कथितं राजन् दृष्ट्वा पार्थान् पराजितान् चारेण विदितं सर्वं तन्मयाऽऽवेदितं च ते॥
en: O king, I have learnt through the spies whatever they talked of after they had seen the sons of Pandu defeated at dice.

sa: नास्ति लोके पुमानन्यः क्षत्रियेष्विति चैव तत्। मन्यसे स च ते राजन् सुमहान् बुद्धिविप्लवः॥
en: O king, you consider there is not a Kshatriya equal to you in the world; it is a great error of your judgement.

sa: एते वासुकिजा नागाः प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहने। अन्ये च बहवो विप्र तथा वै कुलसंभवाः। प्रदीप्ताग्नौ हुताः सर्वे घोररूपा महाबलाः॥ तक्षकस्य कुले जातान्प्रवक्ष्यामि निबोध तान्।
en: These are the snakes, born of Vasuki, that fell into the fire. O Brahmana, numerous other fearful and powerful snakes, born in the family of Takshaka, were burnt in the blazing fire. Hear, I shall mention their names now.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं पृष्टो नरेन्द्रेण पाण्डवेन यशस्विना। धर्माणां परमं गुह्यं भीष्मः प्रोवाच पार्थिवम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus accosted by that famous king, viz., the son of Pandu, Bhishma explained to that king these great mysteries about duty.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा तु तां कथां सर्वे पाण्डवा जनमेजय। लोमशादेशितेनाशु पथा जग्मुः प्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O Janamejya, having heard this story, all the Pandavas with great alacrity proceeded by the way pointed out by Lomasha.

sa: शरणं त्वां प्रपन्नास्मि सारथे कुरु मद्वचः। न हि मे शुध्यते भावः कदाचिद् विनशेदपि॥
en: O charioteer! I seek your protection. Act according to my commands. My mind is not very sanguine. King Nala may come to danger.

sa: स कर्णं युधि निर्जित्य वशे कृत्वा च भारत। ततो विजिग्ये बलवान् राज्ञः पर्वतवासिनः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, having vanquished and brought under his away Karna, he then vanquished the powerful kings who lived on the mountains.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच नैतत् कृच्छ्रमनुप्राप्तो भवान् स्याद् वसुधाधिप। यद्यहं द्वारकायां स्यां राजन् संनिहितः पुरा॥
en: Krishna said: O king of the earth, had I been then present at Dvarka, O king, this misfortune would not have overtaken you.

sa: हयांस्तत्र विनिक्षिप्य सूतो रथवरं च तम्। इन्द्रसेनां च तां कन्यामिन्द्रसेनं च बालकम्॥ आमन्त्र्य भीमं राजानमार्तः शोचन् नलं नृपम्। अटमानस्ततोऽयोध्या जगाम नगरी तदा॥
en: There leaving the horses, the excellent of cars and the boy Indrasena and the girl Indrasena and saluting king Bhima and afflicted and grieving for Nala, the charioteer started from that place and repaired to the town of Ayodhya.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु भीमेन स्मितं कृत्व प्लवगंमः। तद् रूपं दर्शयामास यद् वै सागरलङ्घने।॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Bhima, the monkey chief showed him the forin in which he jumped across the sea.

sa: मातलिरुवाच पुलोमा नाम दैतेयी कालका च महासुरी। दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं ते चेरतुः परमं तपः॥
en: Matali said : (Formerly) a Daitya-female, named Puloma and another great giantess, Kalaka (by name), practised severe austerities for a thousand celestials years.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यत् त्वयोक्तं द्विजश्रेष्ठ वाक्यं श्रुतिमनोहरम्॥ तथा करिष्ये यत्नेन भवतः शासनं विभो। न मे लोभोऽस्ति विप्रेन्द्र न भयं न च मत्सरः॥ करिष्यामि हि तत् सर्वमुक्तं यत् ते मयि प्रभो।
en: Yudhishthira said: foremnost of Brahmanas, the words which you have spoke to me are sweet to hear. O lord, I shall carefully follow them at your command. O foremost of Brahmanas, I have neither avarice, nor lust, nor fear, nor pride. O lord, I shall act according to what you have told me.

sa: कृताञ्जलींस्तु तान् सर्वान् परमेष्ठीत्युवाच ह। विदितं मे सुराः सर्वं यद् वः कार्यं चिकीर्पितम्॥
en: Seeing them all standing before him with joined hands. Parameshti (Brahma) thus spoke to them, “O celestials, I know all that you desire.

sa: यः य देवो मया दृष्टः पुरा पद्मायतेक्षणः। स एष पुरुषव्याघ्र सम्बन्धी ते जनार्दनः॥
en: The lotus-eyed deity whom I saw in days of yore, that foremost of beings is Janardana (Krishna) who has now become your relative.

sa: व्याध उवाच पिता माता च भगवन्नेतौ मदैवतं परम्। यद् दैवतेभ्यः कर्तव्यं तदेताभ्यां करोम्यहम्॥
en: The Fowler said: O exalted one, these my father and mother are the idols I worship with whatever adoration due to the gods.

sa: स्कन्द उवाच सप्तमं मारुतस्कन्धं पालयिष्याम्यहं प्रभो। यदन्यदपि में कार्यं देव तद् वद माचिरम्॥
en: O lord, very well, I shall command, the seventh army corps. Now tell me soon if I am to do any thing else.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच अहं दातास्मि रत्नानां धनानां च विशाम्पते॥ मदर्थे देविता चायं शकुनिर्मातुलो मम।
en: Duryodhana said O king, I shall supply gems and jewels and wealth, and my uncle, Shakuni, will play the dice on my behalf.

sa: कृतार्थं स्वस्तिमन्तं त्वां द्रक्ष्यामः पुनरागतम्। न हि वो वृजिनं किंचिद् वेद कश्चित्पुरा कृतम्।।
en: None can say that you have done any thing sinful before. We hope to see you return in safety and crowned with success.

sa: दभ्यायान्तं सत्यसंधः स राजा। अथाब्रवीद् भ्रातरं भीमसेनं किं नु क्षत्ता वक्ष्यति नः समेत्य॥
en: Thereupon seeing Vidura coming in speed, the virtuous king spoke thus to his brother Bhimsena. “With what message Khattva (Vidura) comes to us?”

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच मृगया शोभना तात गवां हि समवेक्षणम्। विश्रम्भस्तु न गन्तव्यो वल्लवानामिति स्मरे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: O child, hunting and seeing the cattle are both very proper acts. I think the herdsman should not be (completely) trusted.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्रूहि सर्प यथाकामं प्रतिवक्ष्यामि ते वचः। अपि चेच्छक्नुयां प्रीतिमाहर्तुं ते भुजङ्गम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said: Ask (me), O serpent whatever you like. In order to cause your satisfaction I shall, if I can, answer your questions.

sa: क्षमाधर्मः क्षमा यज्ञः क्षमा वेदाः क्षमा श्रुतम्। य एतदेवं जानाति स सर्वं क्षन्तुमहति॥
en: Forgiveness is virtue, forgiveness is sacrifice, forgiveness is the Vedas, forgiveness is Shruti; he who knows all this is capable of forgive all.

sa: तस्य वर्म विभिद्याशु स बाणो मत्सुतेरितः। विव्याध हृदयं पत्री स मुमोह पपात च॥
en: That winged arrow, discharged by my son, pierced his (Shalva's) armour and entered into his heart; whereupon he fell down in a swoon.

sa: बाहुक उवाच एको ललाटे द्वौ मूर्ध्नि द्वौ द्वौ पार्थोपपार्श्वयोः। द्वौ द्वौ वक्षसि विज्ञेयौ प्रयाणे चैक एव तु॥ एते हया गमिष्यन्ति विदर्भान् नात्र संशयः॥ यानन्यान् मन्यसे राजन् ब्रूहि तान् योजयामि ते॥
en: Bahuka said: These horses, respectively bearing one curl on the forehead, two on the temples, four on the sides, four on the breast and one on the back, will, without doubt, reach the country of the Vidharbhas. But, O monarch, should you like others, tell me and I will yoke them for you.

sa: प्रहृष्टा रणे राजन् नापश्यन् सैनिका रविम्॥ उन्नाम्य वक्त्राणि तदा स च राजा जयद्रथः।
en: Highly delighted, O King, your troops and king Jayadratha could not see the sun though they all stood with their heads thrown back.

sa: एतज्ज्ञावा जोषमास्स्व प्रतीपं मा स्म वै कृथाः। मा त्वां पूर्वमहं हत्वा हनिष्ये केशवार्जुनौ॥
en: Knowing this, be silent. do not try to contradict me. Do not make me kill Keshava and Arjuna after having killed you first.

sa: तान् सूतपुत्रो निजधान बाणैः पञ्चालानां रथनागाश्वसंघान्। पर्दयद् बाणगणैः प्रसह्य विद्ध्वा हर्षात् सङ्गरे सूतपुत्रः॥
en: Then Suta's son cut-off with his own arrows the shots of the Panchalas and distressed the cars, elephants and horses of the Panchalas.

sa: ततः शराणां षष्ट्या तु द्रौणिः पार्थमवाकिरत्॥ वासुदेवं च विंशत्या पुनः पार्थं च पञ्चभिः।
en: Thereafter with a group of sixty arrows, Drona's son covered Partha. He then pierced Vasudeva with twenty and Partha again with five arrows.

sa: बभूवैवं च तेनोक्ते तस्य बाहाः स्पृशन्महीम्॥ युधिष्ठिरात् तु तद् वाक्यं श्रुत्वा द्रोणो महारथः।
en: After he had uttered that lie his steeds touched the earth. Hearing these words from the lips of Yudhishthira, Drona that mighty car-warrior.

sa: न पाण्डवेया न वयं नान्ये लोके धनुर्धराः। युध्यमानस्य ते तुल्याः सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Neither the Pandavas, nor ourselves nor any other bowman of the world are equal to you in battle. This I tell you truly.

sa: को हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं कौरवांस्तात संयुगे। अन्यत्र पाण्डवान् युद्धे त्वया गुप्तान् महारथान्॥
en: O Sire, who else could have vanquished the combined army of the Kauravas had not the valiant Pandavas been fighting under your aegis?

sa: किं नु वक्ष्यसि राजानं धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। किं कुर्वाणो मया संख्ये हतो भूरिश्रवा रणे॥
en: Shall you have not to say to king Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma-'Bhurisravas when engaged with another was slain by me in battle?"

sa: संजय उवाच दृष्ट्वा घटोत्कचं राजन् सूतपुत्ररथं प्रति। आयान्तं तु तथा युक्तं जिबांसुं कर्णमाहवे॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O monarch, beholding the mightyarmed Ghatotkacha, rush against the car of Suta's son Karna, with a view to slaughter him,

sa: अहं हत्वा रणे कर्णं पुत्रं चास्य महारथम्॥ प्रीतिं दास्यामि भीमस्य यमयोः सात्यकस्य च।
en: Slaying Karna in battle and his mighty carwarrior son, I will clear the hearts of Bhima and the Twins, as also of Satyaki.

sa: स भवान् मज्जमानानां बन्धूनां त्वं प्लवो भव। विविधानि तवास्राणि सन्ति माया च राक्षसी॥
en: Do you become the raft in this battle to the sinking Pandavas. You possess weapons of various kinds and the potent Rakshasi illusion.

sa: स त्वं कर्ण मया साधु शूरैश्चान्यैर्महारथैः। द्रौणिना त्वं हि सहितो मद्रेशेन कृपेण च॥
en: Now, O Karna, supported by myself, by other heroic mighty car-warriors, by Drona's son, by the king of the Madras and Kripa himself.

sa: संजय उवाच उदीर्यमाणं तद् दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्। अविषह्यं च मन्वानः कर्णं दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Duryodhana, on beholding the vast army of the Pandavas-inflated with wrath and thinking it to be irresistible thus spoke to Karna.

sa: योधाश्च सर्वे ज्वलिताम्बरा भृशं प्रदुद्रुवुस्तत्र विदग्धवस्त्राः शब्दश्च घोरोऽतिबभूव तत्र यथा वने वेणुवनस्य दह्यतः॥
en: The dresses of warriors caught fire and they fled making great noise like that which is heard when a bamboo forest catches fire.

sa: सारूप्यमर्जुनस्येव क्लीपरूपं बिभर्ति च। तदेवैतच्छिरो ग्रीवं तौ बाहू परिघोपमौ। तद्वदेवास्य विक्रान्तं नायमन्यो धनंजयात्॥
en: Although assuming a neuter form he appears like Arjuna. His is the same, head, same neck, and are the same arms resembling maces.

sa: यं हि धर्म चरन्तीह प्रजा राज्ञा सुरक्षिताः। चतुर्थं तस्य धर्मस्य राजा विन्देत भारत॥
en: The one-fourth of the entire virtue earned by subjects well protected by the king in this world goes to the king, O Bharata.

sa: तत्र यात्रा मम मता यदि ते रोचतेऽनघ। कौरवाणां च सर्वेषां कर्णस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: I think, O sinless one, we should go there, if it pleases you as well as all the Kauravas and the high-souled Karna.

sa: यथा प्रीतिर्महाबाहो त्वयि जायेत तस्य वै। तथा कुरुष्व गान्धारे कथं वा भीष्म मन्यसे॥१०
en: So that one of long arins may be gratified with you. Do that, O son of Gandhari. What do you think. O Bhisma?

sa: ततः स तन्मेपमिवापतन्तं विद्राव्य पार्थः कुरुसैन्यवृन्दम्। मत्स्यस्य पुत्रं द्विषतां निहन्ता वचोऽब्रवीत् सम्परिरभ्य भूयः॥
en: Having dispersed the Kuru army, like a violent wind scattering the clouds, that destroyer of foes, Partha, respectfully said to the Matsya Prince.

sa: राजानं राजपुत्रं वा संवर्णयति यः सदा। अमात्यः पण्डितो भूत्वा स चिरं तिष्ठते प्रियः॥
en: The learned courtier who always describes the king and princes in suitable terms can stay long as a favorite in a royal residence.

sa: नारद उवाच नारदोऽथाब्रवीदेनं क्व भवान् गन्तुमुद्यतः। स्वेन वा सूत कार्येण शासनाद् वा शतक्रतोः॥
en: Narada said Where are you about to go? Is it, O charioteer, on your own account or by the command of Shatakratu (Indra)?

sa: त्वमत्र हेतुं जानीषे तस्मात् सत्यं निरुच्यताम्। रहस्यं यदि ते नास्ति किंचिदत्र वदस्व नः॥
en: You are (undoubtedly) aware of the cause of this. Therefore speak truly. If you have nothing to conceal, then relate it to us.

sa: बृहन्नलोवाच नैष शूरैः स्मृतो धर्मः क्षत्रियस्य पलायनम्। श्रेयस्तु मरणं युद्धे न भीतस्य पलायनम्॥
en: Brihannala said To fly is not the practice of the brave and the Kshatriyas; death in battle is preferable to flight in fear.

sa: अहं तस्य भविष्यामि संग्रामे सारथिध्रुवम्। वासुदेवेन हि समं नित्यं मां स हि मन्यते॥
en: I shall most certainly be his charioteer in the battle. He has always regarded me as the equal of the son of Vasudeva.

sa: यथा राज्ञः क्रोधदीप्तस्य सूत मन्योरहं भीततरः सदैव। महातपा ब्रह्मचर्येण युक्तः संकल्पोऽयं मानसस्तस्य सिद्ध्येत्॥
en: The wrath of the king, O Suta, when he is angry; having practiced great austerities and Brahmacharya vows his desire will be fulfilled.

sa: किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि कथं कार्यं भवेन्मम। इत्येवं चिन्तयित्वा सा भीमं वै मनसागमत्॥
en: What shall I do? Whither shall I go? How can my desire be accomplished? while she was thinking thus she thought of Bhima.

sa: तत्र त्वं नरनारीषु शोभिष्यसि मया सह। भार्या मे भव सुश्रोणि तापसं त्यज राघवम्॥
en: There amongst beautiful damsels you will shine with me. O lady of beautiful lips, do become my consort and abandon the ascetic Raghava".

sa: कर्ण उवाच दुर्योधन निबोधेदं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि कौरव। भीष्मोऽस्मान् निन्दति सदा पाण्डवांश्च प्रशंसति॥
en: Karna said: Odescendant of Kuru, O Duryodhana, lay to your heart the words I say. Bhishma always blames us and praises the Pandavas.

sa: सहदेव उवाच गोसंख्याता भविष्यामि विराटस्य महीपतेः। प्रतिषेद्धा च दोग्धा च संख्याने कुशलो गवाम्॥
en: Sahadeva said I shall be the counter of the cows of the king Virata; I am skilled in taming, milking and counting them.

sa: लब्ध्वा वरं तु सुमुखः सुमुखः सम्बभूव ह। कृतदारो यथाकामं जगाम च गृहान् प्रति॥
en: Having obtained the (desired) boon Sumukha became possessed of a really pretty face taken wife, went, according to his desire, towards his home.

sa: कामाभिभूतः क्रोधाद् वा यो मिथ्या प्रतिपद्यते। स्वेषु चान्येषु वा तस्य न सहाया भवन्त्युत॥
en: He who behaves falsely, being subject to desire or to wrath, towards himself or to others, has got no body to help him.

sa: कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च सुदुःखितः। अचे प्रस्थाप्य यानैः स शत्रुघ्नसहितो ययौ॥
en: Placing, Kausalya, Sumitra and Kaikeyi in vehicle at the van (of his train), he set out with a sorrowful heart, accompanied by Shatrughna.

sa: केशिन्युवाच किं ब्राह्मणा: स्विच्छ्रेयांसो दितिजाः स्विद् विरोचन। अथ केन स्म पर्यवं सुधन्वा नाधिरोहति॥
en: Keshini said Are the Brahmanas superior or are the sons of Diti superior, O Virochana? why should not Sudhanvan sit on the sofa?

sa: इदं स्तोत्रवरं भक्त्या शृणुयाद् वा पठेत वा॥ तस्य सर्वाणि कार्याणि सिद्धिं यास्यन्ति पाण्डवाः।
en: O sons of Pandu, he who will listen to, or recite with faith this excellent hymn, shall attain success in all his undertakings.

sa: उत्तर उवाच बृहन्नले गायनो वा नर्तनो वा पुनर्भव। क्षिप्रं मे रथमास्थाय निगृह्णीष्व हयोत्तमान्॥
en: Uttara said O Brihannala, a singer or a dancer, whatever you may be, quickly ascend my chariot and restrain the best of horses.

sa: प्रवासे नगरे चापि संग्रामे शत्रुसंकटे॥ अटव्यां दुर्गकान्तारे सागरे गहने गिरौ। ये स्मरिष्यन्ति मां राजन् यथाहं भवता स्मृता॥ न तेषां दुर्लभं किंचिदस्मिस्मल्लोके भविष्यति।
en: To persons who will remember me, as you have done, in exile, in the town in battle, in danger by foes, in forest, in unapproachable deserts, in seas or in mountains, there will be nothing unattainable in this world.

sa: रणे यं प्रेक्ष्य सीदन्ति हतस्वा वणिजो यथा। कृपेण तेन ते तात कथमासीत् समागमः॥
en: As a Vaishya becomes much distressed on destruction of his wealth, the warriors seeing Kripa become f}accid. How did you fight with them.

sa: किं नो गावः करिष्यन्ति धनं वा विपुलं तथा। दुर्योधनः पार्थजले पुरा नौरिव मज्जति॥
en: What shall we do with these kine or the vast wealth if Duryodhana were to sink like a bark in the Partha water.

sa: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन् प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावृत्तं नराधिप। राज्ञा यदुक्तं भग्नेन तस्मिन् व्यसन आगते॥
en: Sanjaya said "Hear me, O king, as I describe what took place. Listen, O king, to what Duryodhana said when possessed by misfortune.

sa: निवर्तयित्वा रसनां रसेभ्योः घ्राणं च गन्धाच्छ्रवणौ च शब्दात्। स्ततः परं पश्यति स्वं स्वभावम्॥
en: Having withdrawn the tongue from tastes, the nose from scents, the ears from sounds, and the eye from forms, one sees his ownself.

sa: धर्षिता च प्रविष्टा च लङ्का दुष्प्रसहा पुरी। तेन वानरमात्रेण दृष्टा सीता च जानकी॥
en: That monkey alone has invaded and entered the city of Lankā hard to reach and has espied Sītā, the daughter of king Janaka.

sa: जैगीषव्यस्यासितस्य देवलस्य मया श्रुतम्। पराशरस्य विप्रर्वार्षगण्यस्य धीमतः॥ भृगोः पञ्चशिखस्यास्य कपिलस्य शुकस्य च। गौतमस्यार्टिषेणस्य गर्गस्य च महात्मनः॥ नारदस्यासुरेश्चैव पुलस्त्यस्य च धीमतः। सनत्कुमारस्य ततः शुक्रस्य च महात्मनः॥ कश्यपस्य पितुश्चैव पूर्वमेव मया श्रुतम्। तदनन्तरं च रुद्रस्य विश्वरूपस्य धीमतः॥ दैवतेभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च दैतेयेभ्यस्ततस्ततः। प्राप्तमेतन्मया कृत्स्नं वेद्यं नित्यं वदन्त्युत॥
en: I have heard discourses on this subject from Jaigishavya, Asita, Devala, the regenerate sage Parashara, the intelligent Varshaganya, Bhrigu, Panchashikha, Kapila, Shuka, Gautama, Arshtisena, the great Garga, Narada, Asuri, the intelligent Paulastya, Sanatkumara, the great Shukra, and my father Kashyapa. Subsequently I heard this from Rudra and the intelligent Vishvarupa several of the gods, the Pitris, and the Daityas. I have gained all that they say, for they generally describe that eternal object of all knowledge.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच बाणे तस्मिन् निकृत्ते तु धृष्टद्युम्ने च मोक्षिते। तेन वृष्णिप्रवीरेण युयुधानेन संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said After that arrows shot by Drona had been severed and Dhristadyumna rescued by Yuyudhana that foremost of the Vrishnis, o Sanjaya.

sa: तस्या रुदन्त्याः सततं तेन दुःखेन पार्थिव। प्रसादं कुरु मे वीर प्रतिवाक्यं वदस्व च॥
en: O monarch, O mighty one, as she is incessantly lamenting for that distress; so be you kind and give answer to her words.

sa: पुनर्द्रष्टुं हि तानीह प्रीणयन्ति न नस्तथा। भैक्षं च न तथा वीर लभ्यते कुरुनन्दन।॥
en: To see them again would give us no pleasure. O heroic descendant of Kuru, alms are not so easily obtainable now as before.

sa: मैत्रेय उवाच निर्दोषं निर्मलं चैवं वचनं दानसंहितम्। विद्यातपोभ्यां हि भवान् भावितात्मा न संशयः॥
en: Maitreya said Your words on the subject of gift are faultless and pure. Forsooth, your soul has been purified by knowledge and penances.

sa: सावित्र्युवाच ब्रह्मचर्येण शुद्धेन दमेन नियमेन च। सर्वात्मना च भक्त्या च तुष्टास्मि तव पार्थिव॥
en: Savitri said: "O king, I have been pleased with your Brahmacharya life, purity, self-control, observance of vows and all your endeavours and devotion.

sa: अनुनीयमानो हि भृशं देववाक्याद्धि तेन सः। नैच्छद् वोढुं हविः सोढुं शरीरं चापि सोऽत्यजत्॥
en: Though entreated by the celestials, he did not agree to continue to carry the oblations. He then became insensible and abandoned his body.

sa: तं निवर्तयितुं यामि काकुत्स्थं वनवासिनम्। बुद्धिरन्या न मे कार्या गुह सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I go to make Kākutstha dwelling in the woods, turn back. Other intention cherish I none. O Guha, this I tell you truly.

sa: बभूव ह्यस्य हृदये चिन्ता सुमहती तदा। त्वरया चापि दूतानां स्वप्नस्यापि च दर्शनात् ॥
en: Owing to his having seen the dream and the post haste speed of the envoys, a mighty anxiety was present in his heart.

sa: ध्यानमूकत्वमापन्नं चिन्तया सपभिप्लुतम्। अभिगम्य महाराज संजयो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ किं शोचसि महाराज नास्ति शोके सहायता।
en: Possessed of great wisdom, approaching the king the greatly wise Sanjaya, addressed him, saying-Why do you grieve, O monarch? Grief is absolutely useless.

sa: तांश्च त्वं विफलान् कुर्वन् कं नु लोकं गमिष्यसि। राजन् संशयिते मोक्षे परतन्त्रेषु देहिषु॥
en: By dissipating their hopes, to what regions will you go, O king, especially when salvation is doubtful and creatures are dependent on actions?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच त्रि:सप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी कृता निःक्षत्रिया पुरा। रामेणेति तथाऽऽत्थ त्वमत्र मे संशयो महान्॥
en: Yudhishthira said I have doubt very much of what you say about Rama's having twenty-one times rooted the Kshatriyas in days of yore.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अनाथानां जनानां च सनाथानां च भारत। कचित् तेषां शरीराणि धक्ष्यसे विधिपूर्वकम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said It is necessary that our people should burn duly the dead bodies of both who have friends and who have not?

sa: पर्जन्यः पर्वते वर्षन् किन्नु साधयते फलम्। कृष्ट क्षेत्रे तथा वर्षन् किन्न साधयते फलम्॥
en: No result is produced by the clouds pouring upon a mountain. But mighty results are produced by their pouring upon a cultivated field.

sa: यः प्रियं कुरुते नित्यं गुणतो वसुधाधिपः। तस्य कर्माणि सिद्ध्यन्ति न च संत्यज्यते श्रिया॥
en: That king, who always does what is agreeable by natural inclination, acquires success in all his undertakings and is never shorn of prosperity.

sa: तं प्रहस्याब्रवीद् देवो मुनि रागेण मोहितम्॥ अहं न विस्मयं विप्र गच्छामीति प्रपश्य माम्।
en: Laughing at the Rishi who was overpowered by passion, the god said-"I do not, O Brahmana, at all wonder at this. Behold me!"

sa: हतोऽपि लभते स्वर्ग हत्वा च लभते यशः। उभयं नो बहुगुणं नास्ति निष्फलता रणे॥
en: If killed, one acquires heaven. By killing, fame is acquired. Both of these, produce great merit. Battle, therefore, is not unproductive of good.

sa: मया त्ववध्या बहवो घातिता राज्यकारणात्। तानि कर्माणि मे ब्रह्मन् दहन्ति च पचन्ति च॥
en: I have, however, for the sake of kingdom, caused many persons to be killed. Those deeds, O Brahmana, are burning and consuming me.

sa: कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रोणपुत्रश्च वीर्यवान्॥ तेऽपि वै विद्रुता राम दिशो दश भयात् तदा।
en: They are Kripa and Kritavarman and the powerful son of Drona! These also, O Rama, have from fear fled away on all sides!

sa: तदत्र प्रतिवक्ष्यामि किंचिदेव हितं वचः। हते भीष्मे च द्रोणे च कर्णे चैव महारथे॥ जयद्रथे च निहते तव भ्रातृषु चनाघ! लक्ष्मणे तव पुत्रे च किं शेषं पर्युपासते॥
en: I will say a few wholesome words to you about this. After the fall of Bhishma and Drona and the mighty car-warrior Karna, after the slaughter of Jayadratlia and your brothers, O sinless one and your son Lakshmana, what is there now for us to do?

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः कृतवान् सर्व यथा शक्रः पुरोधसा। तथा त्वमपि कौन्तेय सम्यगेतत् समाचर॥
en: Bhishma continued Thus addressed by his priest, Shakra began to follow those instructions. Do you also, O son of Kunti, practise this virtue.'

sa: गांधार्युवाच एष माधव पुत्रो मे विकर्णः प्राज्ञसम्मतः। भूमौ विनिहतः शेते भीमेन शतधा कृतः॥
en: Gandhari said There, O Madhava, my. son Vikarma, praised by the wise, lies on the naked earth, killed by Bhima and wounded horribly.

sa: शिष्ट्यर्थं विहितो दण्डो न वृद्ध्यर्थं विनिश्चयः। ये च शिष्टान् प्रबाधन्ते दण्डस्तेषां वधः स्मृतः॥
en: The rod of punishment is intended for the wicked. It is not intended for self-seeking. They who oppress the good should be killed.

sa: सुषुवे चापि समये पुत्रं सा सरितां वरा। जगाम पुत्रमादाय तमृर्षि प्रति च प्रभो॥
en: When the time came, the best of rivers delivered that child and then went, O lord, taking it with her, to that Rishi.

sa: न हि वैराणि शाम्यन्ति कुले दुःखगतानि च। आख्यातारश्च विद्यन्ते कुले वै ध्रिप्ते पुमान्॥
en: Enmities outlive the enemies, for there is no want of persons who speak of the quarrels of deceased fathers before their surviving children.

sa: चिन्तयामास राजेन्द्र तदा स मुनिसत्तमः॥ मया दृष्टः समुद्रे च आश्रमे च कथं त्वयम्।
en: Indeed, that best of ascetics, O king, wondered much, saying-"How could this one be seen in the ocean and again in my herinitage?'

sa: युधिष्ठिरेण संधिं हि यदि कुर्या मते तव॥ भीतो रणे श्वेतवाहादिति मां मंस्यते जनः।
en: If, in pursuance of your wishes, I make peace with Yudhishthira, people will say that I ani afraid of Arjuna having white horses.

sa: अन्वास्ते च नदी देवं गङ्गा वै सरितां वरा। दधार पृथिवी चैनं बिभ्रती रूपमुत्तमम्॥
en: The best of all rivers, viz., Ganga, waited upon that god. The earth also, assuming great beauty, held the child on her lap.

sa: अजातशत्रो धर्मेण कृत्स्ना ते वसुधा जिता। तां जित्वा च वृथा राजन् न परित्यक्तुनर्हसि॥
en: O you, having no enemy you have righteously conquered the Earth. Having won her, you should not, () king, abandon her without cause.

sa: एत एव त्रयो लोका एत एवाश्रमास्त्रयः। एत एव त्रयो वेदा एत एव त्रयोऽग्नयः॥
en: They are the three worlds. They are the three modes of life. They are the three Vedas. They are the three sacred fires.

sa: ततः शराणां नवति तदार्जुनः ससर्ज कर्णेऽन्तकदण्डसंनिभाम्। तैः पत्रिभिर्विद्धतनुः स विव्यथे तथा यथा वज्रविदारितोऽजलः॥
en: Then Arjuna shot ninety arrows each resembling Yama's rod at Karna. Wounded greatly Karna trembled like a a mountain clapped by a thunder-bolt.

sa: स तेषां प्रतिशुश्राव राक्षसानां तदा वने॥ प्रतिज्ञातश्च रामेण वधः संयति राक्षसाम्। ऋषीणामग्निकल्पानां दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्॥
en: Thereupon in the presence of those ascetics like the flaming fire, inhabiting the Daņdaka forest, he promised to slay those Räkşasas in battle.

sa: न मे विकाङ्क्षा जायेत त्यक्तुं त्वां पापनिश्चयाम्। यदि रामस्य नावेक्षा त्वयि स्यान्मातृवत् सदा॥
en: Nor, had Rāma not always regarded you as his mother, would I hesitate to renounce you, whose heart has been set on sin.

sa: स च मे प्रेषयामास शैवं धनुरनुत्तमम्। सीता च कन्या पद्माक्षी मह्यं वै दीयतामिति॥
en: He sent word to me, saying, 'Do you give me the all-excellent bow of Śiva, as well as your daughter, the lotus-even Sītā.'

sa: संयच्छ वाजिनां रश्मीन् सूत याहि शनैः शनैः। मुखं द्रक्ष्याम रामस्य दुर्दशं नो भविष्यति॥
en: O charioteer, rein in the horses, do you proceed softly. We will see the countenance of Rāma, which we shall never see again.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजां सर्वा एव समुत्सुकाः। ऋषेीताश्च शीघ्रं तु गमनाय मतिं दधुः॥
en: And thereupon they readily received his hospitality. And actuated by the fear of the saint, Vibhāndaka, they bent their minds upon departing soon.

sa: ततो रक्तजलं भीमं लोहितं नाम सागरम्। गत्वा प्रेक्ष्यथ तां चैव बृहती कूटशाल्मलीम्॥ गृहं च वैनतेयस्य नानारत्नविभूषितम्। तत्र कैलाससंकाशं विहितं विश्वकर्मणा॥ तत्र शैलनिभा भीमा मन्देहा नाम राक्षसाः। शैलशृङ्गेषु लम्बन्ते नानारूपा भयावहाः॥
en: And there, after passing the terrific sea of red waters called Yellow, you will behold a mighty knarled Śālmali. There, built by Viśvakarmā, peak-like, gigantic, resembling Kailāsa, (towere) the mansion of Vinata's offspring. There, grim Raksasas named Mandehas, resembling hills, of diverse shapes, capable of inspiring fear, hang head foremost on the rocks.

sa: पृथिव्यां सागरान्तायां यत् किंचिदधिगम्यते। तत् सर्वं तव दास्यामि मा च त्वं मृत्युमाविश ॥
en: Whatever can be obtained in this earth bounded by the ocean I will confer on you, do you not bring about my death,

sa: नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि वनवासे विहृत्य ते। पुनः पादौ ग्रहीष्यामि प्रतिज्ञान्ते नराधिप ॥
en: Having spent five and nine years in the woods, I shall again embrace your feet, O lord of men, after fulfilling your vow.

sa: तमाकाशगतं वीरमाकाशे समुपस्थितः। प्रीतो हृष्टमना वाक्यमब्रवीत् पर्वतः कपिम्॥ मानुषं धारयन् रूपमात्मनः शिखरे स्थितः।
en: Thereupon, with a glad heart assuming the semblance of a man ånd stationing himself upon his own summit, that mountain-chief addressed Hanumān, saying.

sa: ततः सर्वे समागम्य वसिष्ठमिदमब्रुवन्। यथेष्ठं तत् सुविहितं न किंचित् परिहीयते॥ यथोक्तं तत् करिष्यामो न किंचित् परिहास्यते। ततः सुमन्त्रमाहूय वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ निमन्त्रयस्व नृपतीन् पृथिव्यां ये च धार्मिकाः। ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् वैश्याशूद्रांश्चैव सहस्रशः॥
en: Then they approached Vasistha, saying, Everything has been performed properly, without anything being left out. And what you say shall be performed, and nothing words, Do you invite all those kings that are pious, and Brāhmaṇas, and Kșatriyas and Sūdras, by thousands. And do you with due honours bring people from all countries.

sa: न त्वां पश्यामि कौसल्ये साधु मां पाणिना स्पृश। रामं मेऽनुगता दृष्टिरद्यापि न निवर्तते॥
en: I do not perceive you, O Kausalyā. Do you touch me with your hand. My sight having followed Rāma does not return yet.

sa: मा च रोषं कृथाः सौम्य मम शत्रुनिषूदन॥ याचे त्वां शिरसा राजन् मया बद्धोऽयमञ्जलिः।
en: Do not get wroth, O miid one, O destroyer of foes, I beseech you with bent head, and, O king, with joined hands.

sa: अनाथवद् विलपसि किं नु नाथे मयि स्थिते। उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ मा मैवं वैल्कव्यं त्यज्यतामिति ॥
en: Why do you be weep like one forlorn, while I your lord, am living? Arise! Arise! Do not fear, cast off your stupor.

sa: इह राम महातेजाः : सुतीक्ष्णो नाम धार्मिकः। वसत्यरण्ये नियतः स ते श्रेयो विधास्यति॥
en: O Rāma, here in this forest lives a pious and self-restrained ascetic of mighty energy, named Sutiksna. He will bring about your good.

sa: तथातिविद्धा महिषीति कुब्जया समाहता वागिषुभिर्मुहुर्मुहुः। विधाय हस्तौ हृदयेऽतिविस्मिता शशंस कुब्जां कुपिता पुनः पुनः॥
en: Thus momentarily pierced by the wordy shafts shot by Mantharā, the queen exceedingly surprised, laying her hand on her bosom, wrathfully broke out.

sa: स्त्रीतृतीयेन च तथा यत् प्राप्तं चरता वने। सत्यसंधेन रामेण तत् सर्वं चान्ववैक्षत ॥
en: He also saw all that was endured by Rāma firm in promise, with his wife as the third accompanist roaming in the forest

sa: पिता हि राजा काकुत्स्थः श्रीमान् सन्नस्तदा बभौ। परिपूर्णः शशी काले ग्रहेणोपप्लुतो यथा ॥
en: Thereupon Rāma's father, the graceful Kākutstha, became shorn of his splendour, like to the full-moon enveloped at the appointed time during the eclipse.

sa: अथापि च महाप्राज्ञ ब्राह्मणानां मया श्रुतम्। पुरा पितृगृहे सत्यं वस्तव्यं किल मे वने॥
en: Besides, I heard before, O you of great intelligence, in my paternal house from the Brāhmaṇas that I should live in the forest.

sa: यस्य चाहारसमये सूदाः कुण्डलधारिणः। अहंपूर्वाः पचन्ति स्म प्रसन्नाः पानभोजनम्॥ स कथं नु कषायाणि तिक्तानि कटुकानि च। भक्षयन् वन्यमाहारं सुतो मे वर्तयिष्यति ॥
en: How will my son, at the approach of whose meal-time, cooks wearing ear-rings and emulating each other prepare excellent meats and drinks, pass his days, living on fare furnished by the woods, of astringent, or bitter, or pungent taste?

sa: सात्वमग्नि प्रविश वा स्वयं वा विश दण्डकान्। रज्जु बद्ध्वाथवा कण्ठे नहि तेऽन्यत् परायणम्॥
en: Do you enter fire, or dive into Dandaka, or wound a cord round your neck: other desirable way there is none for you.

sa: यद् यथा स महाराजो नालीकमधिगच्छति। न च ताम्यति शोकेन सुमन्त्र कुरु तत् तथा॥
en: O Sumantra, do you act so, that the mighty monarch may not come across anything unpleasant, or be attacked with chagrin through grief.

sa: यद् द्रव्यं बान्धवानां वा मित्राणां वा क्षये भवेत्। नाहं तत् प्रतिगृह्णीयां भक्ष्यान् विषकृतानिव॥
en: That thing which falls to my lot on the destruction of friends and adherents I never accept, even like food mixed with poison.

sa: उपास्य तु शिवां संध्यां दृष्ट्वा रात्रिमुपागताम्। रामस्य शयनं चक्रे सूतः सौमित्रिणा सह ॥
en: Then seeing the night arrived, the charioteer worshipped the beneficent Sandhyā, and then in company with Sumitrā's son, prepared Rāma's bed. on water

sa: स मा पिता यथा शास्ति सत्यधर्मपथे स्थितः। तथा वर्तितुमिच्छामि स हि धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Therefore do I desire to follow what my father commands me, treading in the path of truth, and this is the virtue eternal.

sa: शैलेषु तेषु सर्वेषु कन्दरेषु नदीषु च। ये च नोक्ता मयोद्देशा विचेया तेषु जानकी॥
en: Do you search for Jānaki in all those rocks, woods and streams as well as in such spots as I have not mentioned.

sa: इति तस्यां ब्रुवाणायां चतुर्दश महाबलान्। व्यादिदेश खरः क्रुद्धो राक्षसानन्तकोपमान्॥ मानुषौ शस्त्रसम्पन्नौ चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरौ। प्रविष्टौ दण्डकारण्यं घोरं प्रमदया सह ॥ तौ हत्वा तां च दुर्वृत्तामुपावर्तितुमर्हथ। इयं च भगिनी तेषां रुधिरं मम पास्यति ॥
en: As she said this, Khara wrought up with boundless passion, said, Two human beings accoutred in arins, and wearing bark and dark deer-skins have in company with a female entered this deep Dandaka forest. Do you returni, after slaying them, as well as that wicked one. And this sister of mine will drink their blood.

sa: एक एव हि वन्ध्यायाः शोको भवति मानसः। अप्रजास्मीति संतापो न ह्यन्यः पुत्र विद्यते॥
en: A sonless woman has only one cause of mental affliction. Her only sorrow is “I have no child" and nothing else my son.

sa: क्षिप्तं दृष्ट्वा ततः कायं सुग्रीवः पुनरब्रवीत्। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो रामं तपन्तमिव भास्करम्। हरीणामग्रतो वीरमिदं वचनमर्थवत्॥
en: Beholding that Asura's body thrown thus, Sugrīva, again addressed to the heroic Rāma, before Lakşmaņa and the monkey herd, the following pregnant words.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सुमहान् संशयो मेऽद्य प्रोक्तोऽयं संजय त्वया। प्रजाः कथं सूतपुत्र सम्प्राप्ताः श्यामतामिह॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, a great doubt has arisen in my mind. Why, O son of Suta, people of that country are dark?

sa: संजय उवाच सान्तरे तु प्रतिज्ञाते राज्ञो द्रोणेन निग्रहे। ततस्ते सैनिकाः श्रुत्वा तं युधिष्ठिरनिग्रहम्॥
en: Sanjaya said When Drona had promised the capture of the king under these limitations your soldiers, hearing of the probable capture of Yudhishthira.

sa: व्यक्तं हि दैवं वलवत् पौरुषादिति मे मतिः। यद् द्रोणो निहतः शूरू पार्षतेन महात्मना॥
en: Since that heroic Drona was slain by Parshata of illustrious soul, it is evident, I think, that Destiny is more powerful than exertion.

sa: तावकानां मुखे कर्णः परेषां च धनंजयः। ततो जयाभिसंरब्धौ परम्परवधैषिणौ।॥ अवेक्षेतां तदान्योन्यं समरे कर्णपाण्डवौ।
en: Oking! in that battle, the Kauravas and the Pandavas, looked at each other possessed with ire and each desirous of slaying the other.

sa: न यस्य विजयाकाक्षी विषयं प्राप्य जीवति। यं द्वौ न जहतः शब्दौ जीवमानं कदाचन॥
en: He, meeting whom no person desirous of victory, ever returned with life, he whom when alive the following two sound never left, namely.

sa: अनुत्पन्ने च कार्यार्थे मां त्वं व्याहृतवानसि। तस्मात् त्वमपि न स्वर्गे गमिष्यसि मया विना॥
en: "Without any provocation whatever, you have pronounced a curse on me. Therefore you also shall not go to heaven save in my company."

sa: ध्रुवं वै ब्राह्मणे सत्यं ध्रुवा साधुषु संनतिः। श्रीधुंवापि च यज्ञेषु ध्रुवो नारायणे जयः॥
en: Truth is ever constant in the Brahmana; humility is ever constant in the pious; prosperity ever attends sacrifice and victory ever attends Narayana.

sa: नैष शक्यो हि संग्रामे जेतुं भूतेन केनचित्। तत्र गच्छत भद्रं वो राजानं परिरक्षत॥
en: In battle, this Rakshasa could not be conquered by any creature. So hide yourself to king and rescue him. May good betide you.

sa: मामेव भृशसंक्रुद्धा हन्तुमभ्युद्यता युधि। मनोरथद्रुमोऽस्माकं चिन्तितो बहुवार्षिकः॥ सफल: सूत चायेह योऽहं पश्यामि सोदरान्। यत्राशोक समुक्षिप्ता रेणवो रथनेमिभिः॥ प्रयास्यन्त्यन्तरिक्षं हि शरवृन्दैदिगन्तरे। तत्र तिष्ठति संनद्धः स्वयं राजा सुयोधनः॥ भ्रातरश्चास्य संनद्धाः कुलपुत्रा मदोत्कटाः। एतानद्य हनिष्यामि पश्यतस्ते न संशयः॥ तस्मान्ममाश्वान् संग्रामे यत्तः संयच्छ सारथे।
en: Excited with anger, are all striving to slay me in battle. Beholding ihose brothers of Duryodhana, I see tree of my desirous so long is now fruitful. O deprived of sorrow, where the dusts of chariots spread with shafts into all directions of the sky, Duryodhana stays for fight. Them will I undoubtedly slay today before your very eyes. Therefore, a charioteer, do you drive iny steeds carefully in this encounter.

sa: सकृद् भिन्नं त्वया व्यूहं तत्र तव पुनः पुनः। वयं प्रध्वंसयिष्यामो निघ्नमाना वरान् वरान्॥
en: When the array will once be penetrated into by you, we will again and again destroy it, slaying foremost of the enemies' warriors.

sa: अविध्यत् फाल्गुनं राजन् नवत्या निशितैः शरैः। वासुदेवं च सप्तत्या विव्याध परमेषुभिः॥ ततः क्रोधाभिताम्राक्षः कृष्णेन सह फाल्गुनः। दीर्घमुष्णं च नि:श्वस्य चिन्तयित्वा पुनः पुनः॥
en: And, o king, pierced Phalguna (Arjuna) with ninety keen-pointed shafts then with seventy excellent arrows he pierced the son of Vasudeva. Thereupon with eyes coppery in rage, Phalguna with Krishna breathing long and hot and reflecting again and again,

sa: तस्य दृष्ट्वा तु तत् कर्म परिवठ्ठः सुतास्तव। दहन्तं समरे सैन्यं वने कक्षं यथोल्बणम्॥
en: Beholding that feat of his, your sons in that battle surrounded him on all sides, who was consuming the warriors of your army.

sa: रथं च स्वयं समास्थाय धनुरादाय चापरम्। स्वयं यच्छन् हयान् राजन् व्यधमत् पाण्डवी चमूम्।।
en: Thereafter remounting his own chariot and grasping another bow and himself urging his steeds, he began to consume the host of the Pandavas.

sa: ततः स विह्वलं वाक्यं राम उत्थाय चाब्रवीत्। तिष्ठ भीष्म हतोऽसीति बाणं संधाय कार्मुके।॥
en: Then did Rama, rising up, give vent to these wrathful words:-"Stay, O Bhishma, you are already killed" fixing an arrow to his bow.

sa: यं हि सेनाप्रणेतारं भवान् वक्ष्यति संयुगे। तं वयं सहिताः सर्वे करिष्यामो न संशयः॥
en: The person, who you will consider to be fit to lead our army, in battle, will undoubtedly be chosen to be so unanimously.

sa: आरोहे पर्यवस्कन्दे सरणे सान्तरप्लुते। सम्यक् प्रहरणे याने व्यपयाने च कोविदम्॥ नागाश्वरथयानेषु बहुशः सुपरीक्षितम्।
en: In striking down effectually, in marching forward, and in retreating back; they have been examined in the management of steeds, elephants, and chariots.

sa: पृश्य त्वं मां राजन् कुर्वाणं कर्म दारुणम्। यस्य वीर्यं समासाद्य मन्यसे विजयं युधि॥
en: Behold me, O king, to be doing hard deeds in the battle. Depending on whose prowess you hope for victory in the battle,

sa: यं लब्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः। यस्मिन् स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते॥
en: Acquiring which one considers no other acquisition higher than it, and adhering to which, one is not moved even in the greatest misery.

sa: अव्यक्तरूपो भगवान् शतधा च सहस्रधा। शतधा सहस्रधा चैव तथा शतसहस्रधा॥ कोटिशश्च करोत्येष प्रत्यगात्मानमात्मना।
en: The uninanifest Purusha endued with the six Yoga qualities transforms himself by himself into hundreds and thousands and millions and millions of forms.

sa: नारद उवाच सुखदुः दुःखविपर्यासो यदा समनुपद्यते। नैनं प्रज्ञा सुनीतं वा त्रायते नापि पौरुषम्॥
en: Narada said When the changes of happiness and sorrow appear or disappear, they cannot be prevented by either wisdom or policy or exertion.

sa: यच्चास्य तेजः सुमहद् यच्च कर्म पुरा कृतम्। तन्मे सर्वं यथातत्त्वं ब्रूहि त्वं पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of men, tell me truly everything about his great energy and the great deeds performed by him in days of yore.

sa: उवाच स्वागतं तेऽद्य ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते। संतापश्च न कर्तव्यः स्वगृहे वर्तते भवान्॥
en: Addressing him, he said,-You are welcome to-day. Tell me what I shall do for you. You should not repent. This is your home.

sa: आसनं चैव पाद्यं च तस्मै दत्त्वा द्विजातये। प्रोवाचौघवती विप्रं केनार्थः किं ददामि ते॥
en: Having offered him a seat, and water to wash his feet, she enquired, saying, What is your business? What can I offer you?

sa: स रुद्रो दानवान् हत्वा कृत्वा धर्मोत्तरं जगत्॥ रौद्र रूपमथोत्क्षिप्य चक्रे रूपं शिवं शिवः।
en: Having killed the Danavas and reestablished virtue on Earth, the auspicious Rudra cast off his dreadful form and put on his beneficient shape.

sa: येयमर्थोद्भवा तृष्णा युधिष्ठिर उवाच भ्रातरः पितरः पौत्रा ज्ञातयः सुहृदः सुताः। अर्थहेतोर्हताः क्रूरैरस्माभिः पापकर्मभिः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Cruel and sinful as we are, alas, we have killed brothers and fathers and grandsons and relatives and friends and sons.

sa: पिता धर्म: पिता स्वर्गः पिता हि परमं तपः। पितरि प्रीतिमापन्ने सर्वाः प्रीयन्ति देवताः॥
en: The father is religion. The father is heaven. The father is the highest penance. The father being pleased all the gods are pleased.

sa: कृपणान् सततं दृष्ट्वा ततः संजायते कृपा। धर्मनिष्ठां यदा वेत्ति तदा शाम्यति सा कृपा॥
en: Mercy proceeds from seeing the helpless and miserable persons with whom the world abounds. It disappears when one understands the strength of virtue.

sa: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शुकः प्रोवाच भारत। अस्मॅिल्लोके हितं यत् स्यात् तेन मां योक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Hearing these words of Narada, Shuka said to him, O Bharata, these words:-You should instruct me about what may be beneficial to me!

sa: नाभ्यां कण्ठे च शीर्षे च हृदि वक्षसि पार्श्वयोः। दर्शने श्रवणे चापि घ्राणे चामितविक्रम॥ स्थानेष्वेतेषु यो योगी महाव्रतसमाहितः। आत्मना सूक्ष्ममात्मानं युङ्क्ते सम्यग्विशाम्पते।॥ स शीघ्रमचलप्रख्यं कर्म दग्ध्वा शुभाशुभम्। उत्तमं योगमास्थाय यदीच्छति विमुच्यते॥
en: That Yogin who, carefully practises high vows, properly unites, O king, his sentiency with the self Soul in the navel, the throat, the head, the heart, the chest, the sides, the eye, the ear, and the nose, burns all his mountain-like acts good and bad, and having recourse to excellent Yoga acquires Liberation.

sa: सदा हि वदतां धर्मं सदा चाप्रतिगृह्णताम्। क्षधं च रात्र्याः स्वपतां दिवा चास्वपतां तथा॥
en: Their topic was always virtuous, and they never accepted gifts. They always went to sleep al midnight and never slept during the day.

sa: धर्मं चरत यत्नेन न चाधर्मे मनः कृथाः। वर्तध्वं च यथाकालं दैवतेषु द्विजेषु च॥
en: Duly follow all the duties, and abstain from acts of unrighteousness! Reverentially wait, according to scriptural injunctions, upon the gods and the Brahmanas!

sa: भीष्म उवाच ज्याकर्षणं शत्रुनिबर्हणं च कृषिर्वणिज्या पशुपालनं च। शुश्रूषणं चापि तथार्थहेतोरकार्यमेतत् परमं द्विजस्य॥श
en: Bhishma said ‘Drawing the bowstring, destruction of enemies, agriculture, trade, tending cattle and serving others for money are not proper for a Brahmana.

sa: सुप्राज्यफलमूलानि पुष्पितानि वनानि च। प्रशस्तमृगयूथानि शान्तपक्षिगणानि च॥ फुल्लपङ्कजखण्डानि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च। कारण्डवविकीर्णानि तटाकानि सरांसि च॥ द्रक्ष्यसे दृष्टिरम्याणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च । रमणीयान्यरण्यानि मयूराभिरुतानि च॥
en: You will see blossoming woods garnished with fruits and roots, containing goodly deer, and mild feathered tribes; tanks and pools laughing with blown lotuses, containing pleasant waters, and abounding in Kārandavas; charming mountain-springs; and romantic forests picturesque with peacocks.

sa: न च वै तस्य मृत्युर्वै न कालः प्रत्युपस्थितः। मृत्युहन्तास्य शस्त्रेण स चोत्पन्नो नराधिप।॥
en: O king, he will not die. His time is not yet come. He that will kill him with weapons has also been born.

sa: मयैकेन रणे राजन् ससुहृद्गणबान्धवान्॥ एवमुक्तस्तु कर्णेन पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। अब्रवीद् भ्रातरं तत्र दुःशासनमिदं वचः॥
